products.title: 2023 Finca del Marquesado Rosado Rioja
products.description_html:
Our 2023 Finca del Marquesado Rosado Rioja is an elegant Spanish Rosé crafted by a 4th and 5th-generation winemaking family passionate about sustainable winegrowing.

Glimmering pink with faint violet hues, this Rosado opens with a delicate floral bouquet of lavender, pink jasmine, and peace lily joined by fruity hints of raspberry and peach blossom. Tasting notes reveal fresh-picked strawberries, mandarin peel, and white nectarine. The finish is crisp and refreshing.

Made from a blend of indigenous red grapes, including Garnarcha (70%) and Mazuelo (30%), this Rosado is from a family-run estate in Spain’s renowned Rioja wine region. Planted on pebbled ground above sea level, the vineyard experiences a unique microclimate that makes it possible to grow grapes of exceptional quality and expression.

Bodegas Valdemar over a hundred years of experience in crafting unique wines in Rioja. The family-run winery is committed to supporting biodiversity by using sustainable agriculture practices, and farming is done with respect for the soil and environment.

Each glass of 2023 Finca del Marquesado Rosado Rioja makes a perfect pairing for appetizers, especially marinated mozzarella, hummus, lobster tails, and cheese platters. It also shines alongside fresh salads, creamy rice dishes, and grilled fish.

products.title: 2024 Casa de Alquería Reserva Red Blend Chile
products.description_html: Crafted with both intention and integrity, this sustainably made Red Blend is a harmonious expression of Valle Central's bold, sun-warmed terroir. Sixty percent Cabernet Sauvignon anchors the blend with structure and depth, while thirty percent Carmenère lends its signature velvety richness, and a touch of Cabernet Franc brings aromatic lift and complexity. Deep ruby in the glass, it opens with dark fruit — blackberries, plums — and a subtle herbal note that speaks to the land. The palate is layered and satisfying, with ripe tannins, a hint of green pepper, and a beautifully balanced finish. Ideal with grilled meats, hearty stews, or a well-aged cheese board.

products.description_html: Born from the sun-drenched, river-kissed vineyards of Chile's Valle Central, this Sauvignon Blanc Reserva is a study in freshness and finesse. Pale straw in the glass, it opens with an inviting rush of grapefruit and lime, layered with tropical whispers of passion fruit and melon, and brightened by a touch of fresh lemongrass. On the palate, the texture is crisp and lively, carried by vibrant acidity that flows through to a clean, lingering finish. A certified sustainable wine from a 130-year family legacy, it's the perfect companion for grilled shrimp, zesty ceviches, or any warm-weather table.

products.title: 2024 Tesella Reserva Cabernet Sauvignon Chile
products.description_html: From the granite-soiled vineyards of San Javier de Loncomilla, nestled between two rivers and the shadow of the Andes, this semi-dry Cabernet Sauvignon Reserva is rich, approachable, and full of personality. Deep ruby in color, it opens with an enticing bouquet of blackberry, black cherry, and dark chocolate, layered with subtle vanilla and a whisper of tobacco. The palate is smooth and generous, with well-integrated tannins, a touch of residual sweetness that adds roundness and depth, and a long, velvety finish. A crowd-pleasing pour for those who love bold reds with a softer edge — equally at home alongside beef tenderloin, lamb chops, or a decadent weeknight dinner.

products.title: 2024 Tesella Reserva Carménère Chile
products.description_html: Chile's most distinctive red grape reaches a compelling expression in this Valle Central Reserva from the storied Cremaschi Furlotti family. Deep garnet in the glass, the wine opens with a captivating bouquet of blackberries, plums, and ripe cherries, accented by the Carménère hallmarks of green pepper and warming spice. On the palate, it delivers medium-to-full body with flavors of blackcurrant, dark cocoa, and a hint of mocha, supported by velvety tannins and a well-balanced acidity that carries the wine to a smooth, satisfying finish. Aged in a combination of new and second-use French-American oak, it pairs beautifully with herb-marinated lamb, roasted duck, or earthy mushroom dishes.

products.title: Cinguetto Vino Bianco Frizzante Italy
products.description_html:
This semi-sparkling white is straw yellow in the glass with greenish tints, though don’t let the pale coloration fool you. Each sip of this Cinguetto Vino Bianco Frizzante bursts forward with citrus fragrance and a pleasant bite of green apple. Calming wild flowers lead to a smooth, medium finish rippled with acidity and a steely texture.

Frizzante is a style of wine unique to Italy in which a second fermentation occurs in special, pressurized tanks. With about half the effervescence of a bottle of Champagne or Prosecco, the texture is smoother and calmer when compared to a full sparkler. A frizzante such as this Cinguetto is often sipped with lunch, as an afternoon aperitif, or at a long and restful dinner.

This Cinguetto Vino Bianco Frizzante works a treat as an aperitif, though it’s also exceptional when served alongside roast pork, Thai chicken curry, or crab cakes.

products.title: Abbazia Sparkling Moscato Rosé Dolce
products.description_html: Our Abbazia Moscato Rosé Dolce is the perfect wine to enjoy poolside on a sunny day, with a spirit of celebration. With a lovely pink hue in the glass, this non-vintage rosé Moscato is a sweet and fruity sparkling wine with flavor notes of candied strawberries, peaches, apricots, bubblegum, and cherry licorice. This wine is produced by the Santero family, who own the Abbazia vineyard on the site of an old abbey in the Piedmont region of Italy. This vineyard has been in operation for several generations and is known for its sweet wines. Today, Abbazia uses state-of-the-art technology to ensure the best quality wine, including temperature-controlled fermentation both to obtain naturally-produced CO2 bubbles and to stop fermentation once the desired sweetness is reached. Our Abbazia Moscato Rosé Dolce is best enjoyed with any dessert—a homemade raspberry tart, for example. Of course, you can always enjoy this wine by itself, lounging beside a pool on a long summer’s day. Abbazia Family Winery

products.description_html:
Kelham Vineyards exemplifies Napa Valley prestige. From Oakville's legendary vineyards come Cabernets of remarkable intensity and longevity—wines that reflect both Napa's global prominence and the artistry of family-driven winemaking.

Vivid aromas of black plum, boysenberry, and cassis open first, with hints of anise, dried sage, and crushed stone. On the palate, the wine is poised and precise: structured tannins, fresh acidity, and flavors of dark chocolate, espresso, and mineral accents. The finish is refined, focused, with lingering graphite and savory nuance.

“This is a very pretty, red-fruited Cabernet, marked by elegance and finesse, with the fine-grained tannins and fine-boned acidity emblematic of the excellent 2021 growing season. Widely considered spectacular by growers, the vintage is tracking beautifully here, with a minted structure and chiselled tannins that form a solid foundation. Juicy black cherry, pomegranate, and raspberry fruit are framed by notes of violet and crushed cocoa nibs. There’s energy and drive, building to a long, zesty finish lifted by grapefruit and blood orange acidity.” – 97 Points, Decanter Magazine.

products.title: Kelham Merlot Oakville AVA Napa California 2011 3-Pack
products.description_html:
Kelham Vineyards captures the poetry of Oakville's terroir, where Merlot unfolds with silken grace. Each bottle reflects Napa's enduring beauty and the harmony of nature and tradition.

A rich marriage of black cherry and plum with cocoa dust and forest herbs. Medium‑full bodied, the wine is seductive yet firm, framed by silky, moderate tannins and gentle oak spice. The finish lingers with mocha and a touch of savory leaf, hinting at further complexity with bottle age.

“The wine is impressively fragrant from the moment the cork is pulled, with aromas of red and blackcurrant fruit, tobacco, and loamy earth, alongside dusty rose petal and dried violet notes. Elegant on the medium-bodied palate, it glides in silk-and-satin robes of blackcurrant, spiced plum, dried cherry, and apricot fruit, nuanced by savoury tones of worn leather and black truffle. The finish lingers with walnut liqueur, graphite minerality, and a saline-acid tension. Given the cold and rainy 2011 growing season—a notoriously challenging vintage in Napa Valley—the quality here is exceptional, offering both aromatic precision and structural finesse. In its perfect drinking window now, yet poised to cellar gracefully for another 3–5 years.” – 95 Points, Decanter Magazine

Drink Now through 2038

products.title: Kelham Chardonnay St. Helena Napa California 2022 3-Pack
products.description_html:
Since the late 1990s, Kelham Vineyards has embodied the power and elegance that made Napa an international benchmark. Drawing from Oakville's celebrated soils, every release continues the tradition of excellence that defines this renowned region.

Silky yet bright: pear, golden apple and lemon curd glide over a creamy core, lifted by white-flower perfume and Chablis-style acidity. Partial malolactic and aging in seasoned French oak layer gentle vanilla and nutty finesse, finishing long and balanced.

Talk about a classic Napa Chardonnay. This wine delivers the toasty richness and citrus-kissed fruit so characteristic of top producers like TOR or Rombauer’s single-vineyard expressions. Medium-bodied on the palate, it offers vibrant citrus fruit interwoven with heady orchard and stone fruit notes, all framed by saline-tinged acidity. It’s a Chardonnay full of tension and precision, marrying voluptuous texture with focused intent.” – 94 Points, Decanter Magazine

products.title: Kelham Cabernet Sauvignon Oakville AVA Napa California 2013
products.description_html:
Kelham Vineyards exemplifies Napa Valley prestige. From Oakville's legendary vineyards come Cabernets of remarkable intensity and longevity—wines that reflect both Napa's global prominence and the artistry of family-driven winemaking.

Dark plum, black currant, and black cherry aromas open the glass, while hints of graphite, dark mocha, and dried herbs emerge with air. On entry, the wine is structured yet supple, with firm tannins and vibrant acidity. The mid-palate shows cocoa and cedar, finishing with a lingering savory note. 

“…This is a wine that demands patience and a willingness to roll with its wild edges. Given space to open up, it transforms into something unexpectedly magical—something you’ll want to return to again and again over the course of an evening. Silky textures develop, tannins soften, and a chocolaty quality overtakes the structure, revealing flavours of olive tapenade, tanned leather and tobacco leaf. It’s a wild ride—but one absolutely worth the effort. Decant for at least 45 minutes before serving.” – 94 Points, Decanter Magazine

products.title: Kelham Cabernet Sauvignon Oakville AVA Napa California 2021
products.description_html:
Kelham Vineyards exemplifies Napa Valley prestige. From Oakville's legendary vineyards come Cabernets of remarkable intensity and longevity—wines that reflect both Napa's global prominence and the artistry of family-driven winemaking.

Vivid aromas of black plum, boysenberry, and cassis open first, with hints of anise, dried sage, and crushed stone. On the palate, the wine is poised and precise: structured tannins, fresh acidity, and flavors of dark chocolate, espresso, and mineral accents. The finish is refined, focused, with lingering graphite and savory nuance.

“This is a very pretty, red-fruited Cabernet, marked by elegance and finesse, with the fine-grained tannins and fine-boned acidity emblematic of the excellent 2021 growing season. Widely considered spectacular by growers, the vintage is tracking beautifully here, with a minted structure and chiselled tannins that form a solid foundation. Juicy black cherry, pomegranate, and raspberry fruit are framed by notes of violet and crushed cocoa nibs. There’s energy and drive, building to a long, zesty finish lifted by grapefruit and blood orange acidity.” – 97 Points, Decanter Magazine.

On the palate, the wine is exceptionally crisp and balanced with medium acid. The finish is short, with hints of citrus that give way for a final note of a floral bouquet.

Sicilian winemakers carefully selected the grapes in this 2024 Pinot Grigio, cultivating the vineyard using organic methods without pesticides, herbicides, or synthetic fertilizers. This resulted in a low-sulfite wine with minimal impurities and maximum character. This Pinot hails from Sicily, Italy’s leading wine region, due to its unique volcanic soil and toasty climate. 

As with all Pinot Grigios, this 2024 Calvalari makes a fine pairing to a wide array of lighter cuisine. Think soft cheeses, pasta in cream sauce, roast chicken, and white trout.

products.title: 2020 Calvari Organic Chianti D.O.C.G.
products.description_html:
Calvari is a bright, fruity red from Italy’s Tuscan flagship region, Chianti. Made from organically grown grapes (hand-selected for only the best quality), it’s quintessential Sangiovese: pleasantly medium-bodied with distinct notes of red cherry and earthy spice.  

The man behind the label? That would be fourth-generation winemaker Piergiorgio Castellani, whose quality obsession is reflected in just about everything he does (his residence is even in the center of his organic vineyard, where he can feel close to the land that nurtures his wines). His family has been exporting estate wines from their Tuscan home since 1903, crafting traditional wines that have been adored for generations, while embracing the latest winemaking innovations. 

Pair this lively red with a hunk of good Parmesan, hearty meat cuts grilled simply (olive oil, salt, and pepper), or with Italian classics such as spicy pizza or pasta.

products.title: 2019 Pavillon La Tourelle Bordeaux Supérieur Rouge Magnum 3-Pack
products.description_html:
The red Bordeaux Superieur is characterized by aromatic complexity combining ripe fruits, floral aromas, spice, and a hint of oak. Its grapes are grown in the limestone soils of Bordeaux’s “high country” and then hand-selected according to rigorous criteria to ensure their quality. Throughout its turbulent history, invaders strived to control the Gironde estuary where the wine’s magnificent grapes are grown. 

After the grapes are destemmed and crushed, the wine is fermented and aged in oak barrels, giving it that distinguished, well-rounded structure. With an intense garnet hue, this Bordeaux blend is crafted with Cabernet Sauvignon and Merlot grapes. This forms a pleasant bouquet of black fruit, blackberry, and morello cherry with undertones of spice, smoke, nutmeg, and cocoa. The tannins of this red blend are fine and well-balanced. 

Pair this esteemed Bordeaux blend with smoked red meat and hearty pasta with a tomato-based sauce.

products.title: 2023 Finca del Marquesado Tempranillo Blanco Rioja
products.description_html:
Spain’s flagship region, Rioja, is best known for its smooth, barrel-aged reds. But here’s a pro tip for white wine lovers everywhere: it’s also a hot spot for expressive blancos. Made from 100% Tempranillo Blanco grapes, 2023 Finca del Marquesado Tempranillo Blanco is no exception. 

Finca del Marquesado, from one of the region’s most sustainably focused, historic families, pours bright and clean yellow with subtle shades of green. Opening with a wildflower-driven bouquet, it offers aromas of pear, melon, and white apricot with hints of fennel, anise, and dill. The palate is smooth and flavorful, carrying into a fresh, lingering finish.  

Like how Pinot Gris is a mutation of Pinot Noir, Tempranillo Blanco spun off from Spain’s star red grape and is found exclusively in Rioja. 

Best served chilled, Finca del Marquesado Tempranillo Blanco is lovely on its own or paired with light appetizers, such as creamy cheese platters, calamari, and carpaccio. This is also excellent with main courses of lobster, scallops, chicken kabobs, creamy risottos, and pasta primavera.

images.alt: 2023 Finca del Marquesado Tempranillo Blanco Rioja

products.title: 2023 Pavillion Lavie Rouge Bordeaux
products.description_html:
From the gently rolling hills of Bordeaux comes the 2023 Pavillon Lavie Rouge, a wine that reflects the harmony between land and vine. Born from a blend of diverse terroirs and cultivated by land stewards, this red celebrates both tradition and innovation.  

Made from 66% Cabernet Sauvignon and 34% Merlot, the wine offers a bold yet balanced profile. Stainless steel fermentation and gentle extraction methods preserve the purity of fruit, while concrete aging enhances texture without masking the vibrant character.  

Pour a glass and enjoy its deep ruby color and black cherry and plum aromas, touched by spice. Its smooth palate and refined tannins make it perfect for relaxed dinners or everyday sipping.  

Pair with beef roast, aged Gouda, or a pear tart.

products.title: 2022 Château Grand Pas Bordeaux Rouge
products.description_html:
Uncover the charm of the 2022 Château Grand Pas Bordeaux, a wine that brings the spirit of Bordeaux to life. This 100% Merlot cuvée is crafted from carefully selected grapes, honoring the vine and soil of the clay-limestone terroir. Its deep ruby hue with cherry reflections invites you into a world of vibrant aromas. 

On the nose, classic crushed red fruit notes like strawberry mingle with hints of licorice and a peppery undertone. The palate is equally enchanting, offering a juicy, silky balance followed by a cascade of wild berries and roasted nuances. 

Ideal for pairing with grilled poultry with cream sauce or hearty pasta dishes with mushrooms, this wine reveals its full potential when served chilled at 16-18°C. Enjoy it now or allow it to age gracefully for 2-3 years.

products.title: 2024 Mer de Joie White Wine
products.description_html:
The 2024 Mer de Joie Sweet White is a charming, High Environmental Value-certified wine from France that delights with its aromatic richness and easygoing sweetness.  

Honey, peach, white blossom, and tropical fruit notes fill the glass, creating a lusciously inviting bouquet. On the palate, it’s smooth and round with a balanced sweetness that doesn’t overpower. Ideal as a dessert pairing or aperitif, this white wine is perfect for sipping chilled on a warm evening.  

Try it with fruit tarts, spiced nuts, or soft cheese for a sweet and savory treat.

products.title: 2024 Mer de Joie Red Blend
products.description_html:
The 2024 Mer de Joie Red Blend comes from sustainably farmed vineyards in southern France and is crafted with care under HVE certification.  

This juicy, smooth red opens with blackberry, plum and cherry notes, and a touch of baking spice. A silky texture and soft tannins make it exceptionally drinkable, whether paired with a meal or enjoyed on its own. Its accessible nature and layered character make it a versatile crowd-pleaser.  

Enjoy with grilled burgers, roasted vegetables, or classic comfort foods. It’s the kind of wine that’s always welcome at the table.

products.title: 2021 Terra Volubilis Côtes du Rhône
products.description_html:
The 2021 Terre Volubilis blends Grenache, Syrah, and Mourvèdre from the southern Rhône’s rugged soils.  

Crafted with no added sulfur and bottled unfiltered, this wine reflects a pure and unpolished approach. Expect a layered palate of cherry, green olive, peppercorn, and savory herbs. Smooth and structured, it’s an expressive red with earth-friendly roots and a long, satisfying finish.  

Pair with grilled steak, lentil stew, roasted vegetables, or sharp cheese. This is your go-to Rhône for cozy dinners or casual gatherings with friends.

reviews.title: French. And Cotes. Never...
reviews.body: French. And Cotes. Never turn down

products.title: Terra Mundi Albarino Spain 2020
products.description_html: Albariño is a notoriously difficult grape to cultivate—especially organically—due to excess rainfall and humidity during the growing season. But Terra Mundi persists to offer a bright, expressive bottle with a floral bouquet and a hint of orange. This medium-bodied white is unoaked and texturally similar to Pinot Grigio, just with more crispness.

products.title: Chateau Gravelle Muscadet Serve et Maine France 2020
products.description_html: If you like crisp, refreshing whites that pair with seafood, shellfish, salads, and tasty cheeses, Muscadet is your dream wine! Maligned for a decade by mediocre, widely distributed examples of this fine varietal, the cavalry has finally arrived, proving to be one of the great values in the world of white wine.

images.alt: Chateau Gravelle Muscadet Serve et Maine France 2020

products.title: 2024 Beni Duilio Castellani Montepulciano d'Abruzzo D.O.C.
products.description_html:
Savor the robust flavors of Montepulciano d’Abruzzo DOC 2024, a classic Italian red wine from the Abruzzo region. With an alcohol content of 13%, this wine reveals an intense ruby color and a pleasant scent. 

The traditional vinification process includes soft pressing of fully ripe grapes, controlled temperature fermentation, and a short aging period in wood. The result is a warm, hearty wine with rich black fruit notes, a touch of wood smoke, and tar. 

This bold Italian red pairs perfectly with pizza, pasta, meats, and Parma ham.

images.alt: 2024 Beni Duilio Castellani Montepulciano d'Abruzzo D.O.C.

products.title: 2024 Terre Gobelet Organic Sauvignon Blanc
products.description_html:
The 2024 Terre Gobelet Organic Sauvignon Blanc is a bright, certified organic white from the limestone-rich soils of southern France.  

After a gentle six-hour maceration, the grapes are softly pressed and cold-settled before a cool fermentation. The result is a wine with vibrant acidity, mineral undertones, green apple, citrus zest, and soft herbal aromas. A five-month maturation on fine lees enhances texture, adding a silky mouthfeel and subtle complexity. It’s fresh, clean, and full of vitality. 

Perfect with goat cheese, oysters, or herb-forward seafood dishes.

products.title: Martha’s Fall Getaways White Trio
products.description_html: This carefully curated assortment transports you to picturesque landscapes where sun-kissed grapes yield exceptional flavors. Discover the elegance of an Italian Pinot Grigio, the complexity of a California Chardonnay, and the expressive elegance of a French Bordeaux Blanc.

bottles.title: 2024 29 Barrels Private Reserve Monterey County Chardonnay

products.title: 2024 Terre Gobelet Organic Pinot Noir
products.description_html:
Sourced from certified organic vineyards near the Black Mountain in southern France, the 2024 Terre Gobelet Organic Pinot Noir offers a clean, fruit-driven expression of this noble varietal.  

Grown in a cool, elevated microclimate, this ruby red wine delivers cherry and red berry aromas accented by floral hints and soft earthiness. Gentle fermentation and aging on fine lees give the wine a subtle texture and lift. With its light body, supple tannins, and fresh finish, it’s approachable and refined.  

Enjoy with roasted pork, grilled vegetables, or a mushroom risotto.

products.title: 2024 Due Mari Montepulciano d'Abruzzo D.O.C.
products.description_html:
The 2023 Due Mari Montepulciano d’Abruzzo offers a captivating taste of Italy’s rustic Abruzzo region. Bold black fruit aromas mingle with wood smoke and tar layers, creating a smoky complexity that balances its fruit-forward character.  

This Montepulciano pairs beautifully with classic Italian dishes like Parma ham, sausage pizza, or beef bolognese, making it a versatile choice for hearty meals. Best served slightly below room temperature, this wine embodies the rugged charm of Abruzzo’s picturesque vineyards.

products.title: 2024 L'Artisan by Bruno Lafon Viognier
products.description_html:
Crafted from sun-kissed Viognier grapes grown in Languedoc, this white is Bruno Lafon’s ode to golden fruit and gentle elegance. 

Fermented slowly and aged on fine lees, the wine delivers lush apricot, white peach, and floral notes with a round, creamy texture. A touch of malolactic fermentation adds aromatic depth, while the fresh acidity brings it all into perfect balance.  

Enjoy it chilled with shrimp tacos, grilled scallops, roasted chicken, or a fresh peach and goat cheese salad for a true taste of the south.

products.title: 2024 L'Artisan by Bruno Lafon Cinsault-Grenache
products.description_html:
This 2024 red blend is Bruno Lafon’s tribute to the warmth of southern France. 

Made from 50% Cinsault and 50% Grenache, it’s crafted with care from old vines rooted in Languedoc’s rugged soils. Expect juicy blackberry flavors, spice anise notes, cinnamon, and a satiny texture that’s lifted by a refreshing mineral edge. Aged without oak to preserve the pure fruit, this wine balances boldness with grace.  

Pair with grilled meats, barbecue chicken, roasted vegetables, or mushroom pasta for a delightful southern-style feast.

products.title: 2023 Fairweather Cabernet Sauvignon
products.description_html:
The 2023 Fairweather Cabernet Sauvignon is made for those who appreciate the beauty in simplicity. 

Sourced from the world-renowned Napa Valley, where Cabernet reigns supreme, this wine blends structure with richness. Plush black fruit, violet, and dried herb aromas give way to a palate filled with ripe fig, red cherry, and clove spice. Firm tannins and toasty oak offer structure, while the long finish delivers staying power. 

Enjoy it alongside grilled lamb, short ribs, or mushroom risotto.

reviews.title: Fairweather packs a flavor punch
reviews.body: This wine is complex with a silky mouthfeel. It has a great fruit-forward aroma.

products.title: 2024 L'Artisan by Bruno Lafon Pinot Noir
products.description_html:
From the cool hills of Limoux comes this expressive 2024 Pinot Noir, crafted by Bruno Lafon with precision and finesse.  

It opens with bright red currant and cherry aromas, followed by a hint of mint and earthiness. The palate is juicy, light-bodied, and refreshingly lifted, with soft tannins and a clean, vibrant finish. Aged without oak to let the fruit shine, it’s a delicate yet lively red.  

Pair with charcuterie, smoked turkey, creamy mustard chicken, or roasted mushrooms for a versatile and refined pairing.

images.alt: 2024 L'Artisan by Bruno Lafon Pinot Noir

products.title: Lacalice Rosé
products.description_html:
The 2024 La Calice Rosé hails from the sun-soaked foothills of the Black Mountain in Languedoc, where cool morning mists and warm days foster perfect ripening.  

Made from 100% Grenache Noir, the grapes are harvested at night to preserve freshness and flavor. This vibrant rosé reveals raspberry and strawberry aromas with spice and pepper hints. A creamy mouthfeel from lees aging complements its crisp, bright character. The finish is long, clean, and delightfully refreshing.  

Enjoy with garlic shrimp, Caesar salad, or a vegetable curry for a delicious Mediterranean-inspired pairing.

reviews.title: Lovely dry rosé
reviews.body: A lovely dry rosé, perfect for a warm summer evening. Also an elegantly shaped bottle , good for reuse as a water carafe on the table.

products.title: 2024 Estancia Mendoza Reserve Sauvignon Blanc
products.description_html:
The 2025 Estancia Mendoza’s Sauvignon Blanc is a vibrant white wine from Argentina’s Central Valley. 

Hand-harvested and gently fermented at controlled temperatures, this wine bursts with zesty citrus, juicy peach, tropical fruit, and delicate floral notes. A streak of minerality and refreshing acidity lead to a clean, lingering finish. 

This wine is best served chilled with ceviche, goat cheese, or fresh salads on warm summer days.

reviews.title: I just enjoy this...
reviews.body: I just enjoy this wine. The end of my day

products.title: 2024 Wirbel Zweigelt
products.description_html:
From the cool-climate Danube region, the 2024 Wirbel Zweigelt delivers a polished, easy-drinking profile. 

This ruby-hued red opens with sour cherry, cinnamon, and fresh strawberry aromas. Smooth and balanced on the palate, it offers a clean structure with a spicy edge. The grape’s signature freshness and soft tannins shine through, making it versatile for everyday drinking. Fermented in stainless steel under careful temperature control, it preserves purity and brightness. 

Pair with roasted chicken, grilled vegetables, or Camembert.

products.title: 2024 Magnolia Negra Malbec
products.description_html:
The 2024 Magnolia Negra Reserve Malbec showcases the lush flavors of Mendoza’s high-altitude vineyards. 

This deep, reddish-violet wine opens with ripe red cherry, blackberry, and plum aromas, with vanilla and sweet spice notes from 6 months in American oak and 3 months in bottle. Smooth, velvety tannins and balanced acidity make it a luxurious experience from start to finish. 

This Malbec pairs perfectly with grilled meats, mushroom risotto, or rich stews.

products.title: Vibrazioni Prosecco D.O.C.
products.description_html:
Vibrazioni Prosecco DOC is crafted in Veneto, Italy, using the Charmat method for crispness and finesse. 

This sparkling white opens with elegant floral aromas and layers of green apple and citrus. Fine bubbles dance across the palate with a fresh and harmonious finish. 

Serve chilled as an aperitif or with seafood, sushi, or fresh fruit.

reviews.title: Light, Crisp, and Perfectly Sparkling 🥂
reviews.body: A delightful Prosecco with fine bubbles, refreshing citrus and green apple notes, and a clean, crisp finish. It’s well-balanced, easy to drink, and perfect for celebrations or simply relaxing with friends. Excellent quality and great value. I keep purchasing it again and again and again!

reviews.title: The best prosseco that...
reviews.body: The best prosseco that I had

products.title: Vibrazioni Sparkling Ice
products.description_html:
Crafted in Veneto with 100% Glera grapes, Vibrazioni Sparkling Ice is a playful sparkling wine that brings freshness and flair.  

Made using the Charmat method, it offers elegant perlage and enticing green apple and citrus notes. With 25 g/L of residual sugar, it delivers a soft and sweet flavor profile, beautifully balanced by the grape’s natural acidity. Perfect as an aperitif or served over ice, this sparkling white knows how to brighten the mood.  

Pair with light desserts, fresh fruit, or salty snacks like popcorn or prosciutto-wrapped melon.

products.title: 2022 Au-Delà Muscat
products.description_html:
Step beyond the ordinary with the 2022 Au-Delà Muscat, a wine that defies expectations with its lively, aromatic profile. Sourced from Clarksburg, California, a region renowned for producing expressive, high-quality whites, this Muscat is refreshingly intricate rather than overtly sweet. 

Bursting with fragrant orange blossom and juicy peach notes, the wine delivers a delicate balance of fruit and floral tones layered with a touch of golden honey. Its crisp, bright finish makes it both approachable and endlessly intriguing. 

A natural match for bold flavors, this wine pairs effortlessly with Thai curry, Moroccan tagine, or a fresh fruit salad. Serve chilled and let your taste buds embark on an adventure.

products.title: 2024 Magnolia Negra Cabernet Sauvignon
products.description_html:
The 2024 Finca Magnolia Negra Cabernet is crafted in Las Compuertas, one of Mendoza’s most prestigious subregions. 

This rich Cabernet reveals red fruit, black pepper, and layers of vanilla and caramel from 6 months in French oak. Smooth, structured, and organic-forward, it’s a wine that balances tradition and modernity. With organic and sustainable vineyard practices, this wine brings craft and conscience, showcasing polished tannins and a long, satisfying finish. 

Serve with grilled steak, empanadas, rich pasta dishes, or sharp cheeses.

reviews.title: Awesome wine
reviews.body: Elegant flavor like description

products.title: Vibrazioni Sparkling Rosé
products.description_html:
Vibrazioni Sparkling Rosa blends Glera and Raboso grapes into a pale salmon stunner from Veneto. 

Fine, persistent bubbles carry an intense bouquet of small red fruits and citrus. On the palate, it’s fresh and bright with floral notes of wild rose and a clean mineral finish. 

Enjoy it chilled with charcuterie, strawberry salad, or smoked salmon.

products.title: Reposo Tinto Joven DO Valencia Spain 2023
products.description_html: Bright Grenache, rich Syrah, and complex Mourvedre grapes are often blended together in the Mediterranean, but not all wines are as expertly balanced as this one. From aromas of plum and cherry to smoky and nutty notes, this medium-bodied bottle is ripe for your next meal. It's an ideal partner for dishes cooked outdoors—think juicy steaks and smoked brisket—as well as cheese and charcuterie platters.

images.alt: Reposo Tinto Joven DO Valencia Spain 2023

products.title: 2023 Rotondo Friulano D.O.C.
products.description_html:
From Italy’s Northeast Friuli-Venezia Giulia region comes a charming white wine bursting with acidity and a smooth mineral finish. The Rotondo Fruiliano DOC 2023 is dry on the palate with aromatic wildflowers, grapefruit, and subtle hints of almond. Often mistaken for Sauvignon Blanc, this wine is light-bodied with crisp citrus notes and slightly savory flavors. 

This elegant white comes from the Cargnelutti family, known for crafting wines using traditional Friuli methods since the 1960s. The Rotondo Fruiliano DOC 2023 is well-suited for lighter meat dishes like white fish and roasted chicken. It is also lovely with cooked green vegetables or as an aperitif. Chill slightly before serving to get the most out of those delicate fruit and floral notes.

products.title: Vague de Bonheur Cabernet - Merlot Bordeaux France 2023
products.description_html: Finding an affordable, aromatic, and go-to grilling wine (that also happens to be crafted sustainably in Bordeaux) is no longer a tall order. This Cabernet and Merlot blend features ripe fruit flavor including cherry and prune alongside mellow tannins that let you know they’re around without being overbearing. Be sure to let this wine breathe—swirl it in the glass to enjoy woody, savory notes that emerge with some air.

images.alt: Vague de Bonheur Cabernet - Merlot Bordeaux France 2023

products.title: Haast Sauvignon Blanc New Zealand 2022
products.description_html: Sauvignon Blanc is one of the world’s most popular varietals. Organically grown in New Zealand, this bottle is aromatic, crisp, and a total crowd-pleaser with notes of passionfruit, peach, and kiwi. For a perfect pairing, enjoy a glass on a warm day served alongside white fish, asparagus, roasted potatoes, and a dollop of aioli.

products.title: Xavier Frissant Sauvignon Blanc Touraine France 2023
products.description_html: Fresh and citrusy with mineral undertones, Sauvignon Blanc is an anytime wine for gatherings of all sizes. With stone fruit aromas as the star, this bottle shines alongside seafood (try shrimp tacos, scallop risotto, or roasted salmon) as well as tangy goat cheese. Our advice: Keep a bottle in the fridge so it’s always ready for impromptu dinners.

images.alt: Xavier Frissant Sauvignon Blanc Touraine France 2023

products.title: Cibolo Monastrell Jumilla Spain 2021
products.description_html: Bring on the grill! This red grown in the sunny hills of southern Spain is ripe, full-bodied, and jammy. The elegant fragrance with notes of vanilla and new oak makes a perfect pairing for grilled meats, ribs, and spicy fare. Uncork it with friends (and maybe keep a few spare bottles on hand).

reviews.body: We’re glad you liked it!

products.title: 2022 Sinuoso Pinot Noir Reserva
products.description_html:
Hailing from Chile’s Central Valley, the 2022 Sinouso Pinot Noir Reserva is a beautifully crafted wine that embodies finesse and balance. Its brilliant ruby-red color leads to an inviting red cherry, raspberry, and floral bouquet, setting the stage for a palate rich with strawberries, cranberries, and a touch of earthy spice. 

With supple tannins and vibrant acidity, this Pinot Noir delivers a smooth, lingering finish.  

Enjoy it with roasted duck breast, grilled salmon, or wild mushroom risotto for a truly elevated dining experience.

products.title: 2022 Kawra Red Blend Reserva
products.description_html:
The 2022 Kawra Red Blend Reserva harmonizes 60% Cabernet Sauvignon, 30% Carménère, and 10% Cabernet Franc for a bold, well-rounded experience. With dark fruit, green pepper, and spice notes, this wine offers velvety tannins and a smooth, satisfying finish. 

Crafted sustainably in Chile’s Central Valley, it’s an ideal companion for grilled steaks, robust stews, or aged cheddar. Serve chilled at 16-18°C to unlock its full depth.

products.title: Les Allees De Boisvent Rose Bordeaux France 2023
products.description_html:
Crafted from Cabernet Franc and Cabernet Sauvignon grown in the heart of Bordeaux’s Entre-deux-Mers region, the 2023 Les Allées de Boisvent Rosé captures the elegance of southern French rosé. This wine owes its freshness and finesse to traditional winemaking methods, including a brief maceration that draws out its light salmon hue and delicate fruit flavors. 

Expect a graceful white flower and stone fruit bouquet, followed by a refreshing palate layered with peach and apricot. It finishes long, light, and clean — a quintessential sip for sunny afternoons. 

Pair it with Niçoise salad, grilled shrimp, or goat cheese crostini.

reviews.title: Delicious
reviews.body: This is very light, fresh and a lovely rose Bordeaux!

reviews.title: Crisp and refreshing.
reviews.body: Crisp and refreshing. Dry with a very slight acidity. Easy on the pallet. A satisfying summer wine.

images.alt: Les Allees De Boisvent Rose Bordeaux France 2023

products.title: 2022 Kawra Carménère Reserva
products.description_html:
The 2022 Kawra Carménère Reserva celebrates Chile’s iconic varietal with a deep garnet hue and a blackberry, plum, and subtle green pepper bouquet. On the palate, velvety tannins and a touch of cocoa lead to a balanced, lingering finish. 

Sustainably crafted in the Central Valley, this wine’s richness pairs wonderfully with herb-marinated grilled lamb chops or mushroom risotto. For the best tasting experience, serve slightly below room temperature.

products.title: Award-Winning Reds Gift Set
products.description_html: Experience the best of bold reds with these world-renowned wines from Spain, France, and Argentina. You’ll experience 2021 Valanda Tempranillo (94-Point Platinum at the 2023 Monterey International Wine Competition), 2020 Beau Palais Bordeaux Rouge (90-Point Gold at the 2022 San Diego International Wine Challenge), and 2021 Casa del Pináculo Malbec (93-Point Gold at the 2023 Toast of the Coast Wine Competition). We’ll also include an Easy Grip Professional Waiter’s Corkscrew so you can easily uncork your distinguished blends. Experience the joy and warmth of these award-winning red wines.

products.title: Bordeaux Gift Set
products.description_html: Give the gift of the best of French wine with these voluptuous Bordeaux blends. Treat your loved ones to 3 delectable red wines from renowned brands. This includes 2021 Sempiternité Bordeaux Rouge (93-Point Gold at the 2023 Winemaker Challenge), 2020 Beau Palais Bordeaux Rouge (90-Point Gold at the 2022 San Diego International Wine Challenge), and 2020 Château Chamanara Bordeaux Rouge (90-Point Gold at the 2023 Monterey International Wine Competition). We’ll also include an Easy Grip Professional Waiter’s Corkscrew so you can easily uncork your distinguished blends. Cheers to elegance this holiday season with bold, fruity, and peppery Bordeaux blends everyone will enjoy.

products.title: Simple Life Wine-Based Cosmopolitan Cocktail
products.description_html:
Simple Life’s Wine-Based Cosmopolitan is your shortcut to sipping like a star—no shaker required. This bold pink cocktail blends Simple Life pink wine with real fruit juice and all-natural ingredients to deliver a bright, balanced, and bar-worthy experience. 

Expect juicy citrus layered with tropical fruit and floral hibiscus spice for a finish that’s both zesty and smooth. It’s the perfect pour for rooftop happy hours, girls’ nights in, or reliving your favorite rom-com moments. 

Serve chilled in your favorite glass or over ice for that extra “just stepped out” sparkle.

products.title: Simple Life Wine-Based Lemon Drop Cocktail
products.description_html:
Simple Life’s Wine-Based Lemon Drop turns your favorite tart-sweet cocktail into a ready-to-sip luxury. Blending Simple Life white wine with real lemon juice, lemongrass, and just a touch of vanilla, it’s a flavor-forward twist on the classic. 

Juicy citrus meets soft florals and sweet undertones, making it ideal for sunny afternoons, backyard brunches, or anytime you want to feel a little fancy without lifting a shaker. 

Serve chilled in a coupe glass or over crushed ice with a lemon twist.

reviews.title: Love this wine cocktail.... highly recommend.
reviews.body: Love this wine cocktail. This is not my 1st time purchasing this lemon drop cocktail. Cold and refreshing on a hot summer day. I hope they keep it around for future purchases.

reviews.title: Perfect summer after dinner...
reviews.body: Perfect summer after dinner drink!

images.alt: Simple Life Wine-Based Lemon Drop Cocktail

products.title: 2024 Muchas Manos White Blend
products.description_html:
Our 2024 Muchas Manos White Blend is from La Mancha, Spain where hundreds of thousands of acres of vineyards cover this historic viticulture region. Winemakers utilize the gurthy vines to produce well-rounded, plentiful grapes that once skin and stem are removed become beautiful white wine. 

A Spanish staple to many, this bright yellow glass has iridescent green strokes with relaxing fresh aromas of herbs, apple, peach and tropical fruits. A persistent aftertaste holds the silky finish on the tongue. 

Paella is your friend when pairing this wine. Try a seafood paella or standalone seafood dish like jumbo shrimp or grilled white fish.

products.title: 2024 Terra Sara Verdejo
products.description_html:
As delicious as its preceding award-winning vintage, 2024 Terra Sara Verdejo is a fresh, versatile white wine from one of Spain’s most renowned wine regions.  

Dry and light to medium-bodied, this Verdejo has pleasant approachable character. Aromas of apple, citrus, and fresh herbs carry into a lively palate displaying peach, melon, and lime notes. The finish is marked by thirst-quenching acidity and a splash of tangerine. 

Fans of Sauvignon Blanc and Pinot Grigio are sure to appreciate vibrant Verdejo, a white grape that grows almost exclusively in Spain. Grapes were nourished in Rioja, located in Northern Spain. Home to vineyard-covered hills, this region experiences a combination of cooler Atlantic influences and warmer Mediterranean influences, resulting in expressive, high-quality wines. Rioja is most known for its reds, making this white a hidden gem. 
 
This Verdejo is from Zuazo Gastó, an award-winning family winery that has been crafting artisanal wines since 1850. Their Terra Sara line represents easy-drinking wines meant to be enjoyed with a variety of foods while in the company of good friends. 

Best served chilled, 2024 Terra Sara Verdejo Spain is lovely sipped on its own or paired with cheese plates, fresh salads, shellfish, light fish dishes, and grilled vegetables.

reviews.title: Just delighted with this...
reviews.body: Just delighted with this wine!!!

products.title: 2024 Terra Sara Cuvee de la Familia Tempranillo
products.description_html:
Zuazo Gastón’s a major name in Spain’s marquee region of Rioja, with a cascade of top international accolades to their name. They make delicious wines across the country, too, like this oak-aged Cuvée de la Familia Tempranillo (a silver medalist).  

Look for a cherry tobacco nose that opens up to a palate bursting with black cherry, blackberry, fresh herbs and notes of baking spice. With its juicy acidity and smooth, fruit-forward nature, it’ll be a versatile match with a fun spread of Spanish tapas. We like Manchego cheese with jamón Serrano and lamb albóndigas (meatballs).

images.alt: 2024 Terra Sara Cuvee de la Familia Tempranillo

products.title: 2024 Muchas Manos Red Blend
products.description_html:
Our 2024 Muchas Manos Red Blend is home to La Mancha, Spain, a viticultural dream of over 190,000 hectares of pristine vineyards. The vines are strong willed to withstand harsh conditions. 

A gripping, bold blend with high tannins and dry mouthfeel, this wine has a palate of dark chocolate, mocha, and espresso complemented by notes of strawberry for a holistic sip. 

This Spanish wine should be drank with beef, veal or grilled dark meat chicken. Additionally would go splendidly with a demanding pasta dish with full tomatoes and a bolognese hearty sauce.

reviews.title: Received Merlot instead...
reviews.body: Twice I've ordered this red blend, but both times I received Merlot instead.   Since Merlot isn't my favorite I gave the first bottle away, but when I got the second, I just went ahead and opened it.   It was not bad.

reviews.title: Always very consistent in...
reviews.body: Always very consistent in flavor & quality!

products.title: 2024 Rotondo Pinot Grigio Rosé
products.description_html:
Rotondo Pinot Grigio Rosé is a refined rosato born from the sun-drenched sandstone slopes of the Veneto region. Crafted with care and fermented in stainless steel, it boasts clarity, freshness, and the effortless elegance you expect from top Italian rosés. 

Pale pink in color, it opens with soft floral aromas and juicy pear on the palate. Dry and smooth, this wine is ideal for easy spring sipping, sunset aperitivos, or fresh appetizers. 

Serve well chilled with grilled seafood, fresh salads, or a classic margherita pizza.

reviews.title: A light tasteful summer...

products.title: 2024 Cantina Etrusca Sangiovese I.G.T.
products.description_html:
From the rolling hills of central Italy comes the 2024 Cantina Etrusca Sangiovese, a structured yet elegant red wine made for lovers of traditional Italian fare. Harvested in September and aged in stainless steel to preserve its purity, this Tuscan gem reveals layered aromas of violet, iris, and ripe red berries. 

On the palate, it’s smooth with gentle tannins, balanced acidity, and a clean finish that makes it perfect for most classic Italian dishes. 

Serve slightly below room temp with pizza, roast chicken, or herbed pork loin.

products.title: 2024 Rotondo Pinot Grigio
products.description_html:
The 2024 Rotondo Pinot Grigio is a benchmark white wine from the heart of northern Italy’s Veneto region. Grown in high-elevation vineyards with sandstone soils, this wine embodies purity and freshness. 

Straw yellow in the glass, it offers bright citrus and apple notes, with a clean, mineral-driven finish. Stainless steel vinification preserves its delicate aromatics and natural acidity. 

Serve chilled alongside grilled shrimp, light pasta dishes, or soft cheeses.

products.title: 2021 Finca Antigua Crianza Cabernet Sauvignon
products.description_html:
The 2021 Finca Antigua Crianza Cabernet Sauvignon is a bold, complex wine from Spain’s La Mancha region, known for its diverse and expressive reds. Rich blackberry and plum aromas are complemented by hints of coffee and savory tapenade, creating an inviting nose.  

This wine balances fruity and earthy notes on the palate with subtle vanilla and coconut flavors derived from American oak barrel aging. Peppery tobacco undertones and smooth tannins complete its sophisticated profile.  

This robust red is perfectly suited for steak dinners, aged cheeses, or a decadent dark chocolate dessert. It offers a truly indulgent experience.

products.title: 2021 Finca Antigua Crianza Merlot
products.description_html:
From La Mancha’s sun-drenched regions, the 2021 Finca Antigua Crianza Merlot stands out for its lush, fruit-forward character and rich complexity. Vibrant plum and red berry notes dominate the palate, complemented by chocolate and spice cake undertones.  

Aged for 11 months in French oak barrels, this wine achieves a smooth, full-bodied texture with a touch of toasted warmth. Its balanced acidity and rounded tannins make it an excellent pairing for barbecue, grilled vegetables, pasta with hearty red sauces, or a juicy burger. It is best served slightly below room temperature to bring out its nuanced flavors.

products.title: 2022 Château Bois de Tau Côtes du Bourg Bordeaux Rouge France
products.description_html:
Experience the elegance of Château Bois de Tau Rouge Bordeaux 2022, crafted by renowned winemaker Delphine Faure in Bordeaux's prestigious Cotes de Bourg appellation. This wine, produced using traditional Bordeaux vine training and sustainable farming methods, boasts HVE3 certification for high environmental value. 

The wine's aromatic nose reveals ripe blackcurrant, blackberry, and red currant with hints of violet and cocoa bitterness. On the palate, it delivers a balanced blend of fruitiness and subtle floral notes, making it an excellent choice for those who appreciate a refined Bordeaux. 

Enjoy this wine with rich meat dishes like game meats, barbecue, and roasted scallops.

images.alt: 2022 Château Bois de Tau Côtes du Bourg Bordeaux Rouge France

products.title: 2022 Château Gazin-Morier Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux
products.description_html:
The 2022 Château Gazin Morier is crafted from 20-year-old vines on a high hill with south-west exposure in Blaye, Bordeaux. The clay-limestone soil retains water through the hot season, ensuring consistent grape maturity. The vineyard is HVE3-certified for sustainable viticulture. 

A blend of 60% Merlot and 40% Cabernet Sauvignon, this wine undergoes cold maceration, fermentation in thermo-regulated vats, and 10 months of aging in French oak. 

The result is a limpid ruby wine with a juicy nose of red berries and violet, followed by fig, blackcurrant, and star anise. The palate is fresh, balanced, and elegant with fine tannins and a clean finish. 

Serve with roast meats or mushroom dishes.

products.title: 2020 Château Fontarabie Blaye Côtes de Bordeaux France
products.description_html:
The 2020 Chateau Fontarabie is a 70% Merlot and 30% Cabernet Sauvignon blend from 15 hectares of south-facing vines overlooking the Gironde Estuary. The estate practices sustainable farming and holds the HVE3 certification. 

The wine is aged for 10 months in French oak barrels from five different coopers, offering layered complexity. It reveals ripe cassis, fresh blueberry, violet, spice, and hints of vanilla, toasted hazelnut, and cocoa on the palate. 

Serve at 16–18°C with roasts, grilled meats, or hearty stews.

products.title: 2024 Magistrale Chardonnay I.G.T. Veneto
products.description_html:
Harvested in early September from clayey and sandy soils, the 2024 Magistrale Chardonnay is softly pressed, fermented at controlled temperatures in stainless steel tanks, and refined in bottle. 

This straw-yellow wine offers an elegant and delicate bouquet with fresh fruit tones. The palate is rich, harmonious, and persistent, delivering balance and freshness in every sip. 

Serve with grilled fish, roast chicken, or creamy pasta dishes.

products.title: 2024 Magistrale Cabernet Sauvignon I.G.T. Veneto
products.description_html:
The 2024 Magistrale Cabernet Sauvignon is grown on clayey and sandy soils at 100–150 meters in Veneto. Harvested in mid-September, the grapes undergo maceration on skins and fermentation in stainless steel at a controlled temperature. 

This ruby red wine reveals deep black cherry, plum, and fig flavors with subtle floral, spicy violet, and black pepper notes. Aged in stainless steel and refined in bottle, it offers a rich palate and well-rounded mouthfeel. 

Serve with grilled meats or savory pasta dishes.

products.title: 2024 Magistrale Sauvignon Blanc I.G.T. Veneto
products.description_html:
The 2024 Magistrale Sauvignon Blanc is harvested in early September from vineyards planted on clayey and sandy soils in the Veneto region. The wine is softly pressed, fermented with selected yeasts in stainless steel tanks, and then refined in bottle. 

With a straw yellow color and greenish highlights, this Sauvignon Blanc displays fruity and floral aromas with citrus and elderflower notes. The palate is crisp, savory, and persistent. 

Serve chilled and pair with light seafood or salads with goat cheese.

products.title: 2024 Magistrale Merlot I.G.T. Veneto
products.description_html:
The 2024 Magistrale Merlot is grown on gravelly soil in Veneto at 100–150 meters elevation. Harvested in September, the grapes are macerated on skins, vinified in steel tanks at controlled temperatures, and refined in bottle. 

Ruby red with violet hints, this wine offers vinous aromas and fresh herbal notes. The palate is lively and savory, with gentle tannins that make it an easy-drinking, everyday red. 

Serve with grilled vegetables, charcuterie, or tomato-based pasta.

reviews.title: So smooth
reviews.body: It was one of the smoothest wines I have ever had.  Not too sweet and no bitterness. Delicious.

products.title: Tesoro Vite Sparkling Moscato
products.description_html:
Tesoro Vite Sparkling Moscato is a golden-hued wine made from peak-harvest Moscato grapes grown on limestone and sand marls at 250m elevation. Secondary fermentation occurs in steel to preserve its vibrant character and reach the perfect pressure of 2.8 ATM. 

Fragrant aromas of Muscat grapes, musk, and fresh flowers lead into a delicately sweet palate that balances freshness and richness. The foam is persistent and smooth. 

Serve well chilled at 8°C. Perfect as a celebratory aperitif or paired with desserts and fruit.

products.title: 2023 Beni Duilio Castellani Montepulciano d'Abruzzo D.O.C.
products.description_html:
Savor the robust flavors of Montepulciano d’Abruzzo DOC 2023, a classic Italian red wine from the Abruzzo region. With an alcohol content of 13%, this wine reveals an intense ruby color and a pleasant scent. 

The traditional vinification process includes soft pressing of fully ripe grapes, controlled temperature fermentation, and a short aging period in wood. The result is a warm, hearty wine with rich black fruit notes, a touch of wood smoke, and tar. 

This bold Italian red pairs perfectly with pizza, pasta, meats, and Parma ham.

products.title: 2022 Beni Duilio Castellani Vernaccia di San Gimignano D.O.C.G.
products.description_html:
The 2022 Beni Duilio Vernaccia di San Gimignano truly expresses Tuscany’s winemaking legacy. It is produced exclusively in the medieval town of San Gimignano. As Italy’s first DOCG wine, it represents a historic benchmark of quality. 

Grown on sandy, clayey, and calcareous soils, the Vernaccia grapes are softly pressed and fermented under controlled temperatures to preserve their delicate fragrance. The result is a dry and harmonious white wine with subtle fruit on the nose, saline minerality, and a refined almond finish. 

Serve chilled at 8–10°C. Enjoy as an aperitif or with seafood, fried dishes, pasta with white meat sauce, and roasted chicken with potatoes.

products.title: 2022 Bertoli Primitivo di Puglia I.G.T.
products.description_html:
Crafted from vineyards in the sun-drenched provinces of Taranto and Brindisi, Brotello Primitivo reflects the deep warmth of southern Italy. The Mediterranean climate and proximity to the Ionian Sea create the ideal setting for bold, expressive fruit. 

Fermented at 23–25°C using traditional methods, this wine is intense red with garnet reflections. Its bouquet delivers ripe dark fruit, complemented by spicy notes and licorice. The structure is warm and persistent—a classic Primitivo character. 

Serve at 16–18°C with roasts, hearty pasta, seasoned cheese, and rich soups.

products.title: 2020 Beni Duilio Castellani Sangiovese di Toscana I.G.T
products.description_html:
Experience the essence of Tuscany with Beni Duilio Sangiovese Toscana IGT 2020. This 13.5% alcohol wine is crafted using traditional vinification methods, with mature Sangiovese grapes harvested and processed in soft membrane presses. 

Fermentation occurs at controlled temperatures with prolonged skin contact, followed by malolactic fermentation and at least one year of aging. The wine boasts an intense color with a red berry rim and offers aromas of cherry, dark fruits, and wildflowers. 

On the palate, enjoy silky tannins and flavors of dried strawberries, plums, violets, and red cherries. 

Robust and balanced, it's perfect with pasta dishes and grilled red meats, served at 18-20°C.

products.title: 2024 Due Mari Sangiovese I.G.T.
products.description_html:
The 2024 Due Mari Sangiovese is a stunning example of Italian craftsmanship. With its deep ruby hues, this wine delivers a harmonious balance of flavors, showcasing plum, cherry, and bramble fruit notes accented by violet and pepper undertones.  

Cultivated in the sunlit vineyards of Puglia, the Sangiovese grapes are nurtured by limestone-rich soils, imparting a dry, refined elegance. Pair this vintage with Fiorentina steak, Tuscan salami, or gnocchi in a sage and butter sauce for a meal that celebrates Italy’s culinary traditions.

products.title: 2021 Due Mari Maremma Toscana I.G.T.
products.description_html:
Taste the “super” in Supertuscan with our 2021 Due Mari Maremma Toscana I.G.T. Cultivated by winemakers quickly rising through the ranks in the Italian wine scene, this red displays deep and layered cherry notes that contrast sweetly against hints of white chocolate. Secondary notes of red currant impress with lively, vibrant character. Dry complexity lingers warmly on the palate, giving way to a medium balsamic finish.

This Toscana hails from the Maremma district of Abruzzo, known colloquially as Italy’s Wild West. The coastline of white sandy beaches and strawberry trees gives way to picturesque Tuscan hills adorned with olive trees and rolling vineyards. From this land, Due Mari carefully hand-selects the most concentrated fruit in their pruned grapes and bottles the resulting wine with care, as illustrated in this magnificent Italian red.

Pair this Due Mari with grilled meats, steaks, and game meats to create a true Italian dinner.

reviews.title: Rich smooth red wine.
reviews.body: Nicely full bodied with a cherry plum after taste.

products.title: 2024 Due Mari Pinot Grigio I.G.T.
products.description_html:
Enjoy zesty refreshment in 2024 Due Mari Pinot Grigio I.G.T., hailing from sun-drenched Sicily, Italy. This dry, versatile white wine follows in the delicious footsteps of the previous award-winning vintage.  

Gleaming golden-yellow in the glass, this Pinot Grigio opens with fresh aromas that evoke a summer day spent by the sea. Punchy tropical fruits like pineapple join citrus and grapefruit notes on the palate, which has crisp acidity and a clean, thirst-quenching finish.

Grapes were cultivated under the warmth of the Mediterranean sun on the beautiful island of Sicily, home to dark soils rich with volcanic minerals. These are near-perfect conditions for grape-growing, and Sicily has more than 2500 years of winemaking history, playing an important role in showcasing high-quality wines from the Mediterranean. 

This Pinot Grigio is produced by Castellani, a 4th generation family winery that began crafting traditional wines in 1903. While the Tuscan-based winery has evolved over the years, the family’s passion for grape-growing and creating delicious, memorable wines has remained. For Piergiorgio Castellani, “the quality of the wine begins in the vineyard,” and he is devoted to nurturing the land while embracing innovative winemaking methods.

Best served chilled, 2024 Due Mari Pinot Grigio I.G.T. is delightful when sipped on its own. You’ll also want to explore this wine with summer-centric dishes like grilled chicken, fresh fish, and lively salads.

reviews.title: Fruity and bright!
reviews.body: Fruity and bright!

products.title: Tesoro Vite Sparkling Wine Moscato I.G.T.
products.description_html:
Straight from the picturesque vineyards of Pavia, Tesoro Vite Vino Dolce is a charming expression of Italy’s beloved Moscato. This delightful sweet wine glows with a light straw yellow hue and releases enchanting fresh citrus, ripe apricot, and fragrant sage aromas.  

Produced with natural sugars, this Moscato is lively and well-balanced, offering a crisp and refreshing sweetness that lingers on the palate. The limestone and sand-rich soil lend a mineral complexity that enhances its vibrant fruit character.  

Best served chilled at 8°C, this wine pairs beautifully with fruit tarts and soft cheeses or can be enjoyed on its own as an aperitif.

The 2023 Due Mari Montepulciano d’Abruzzo offers a captivating taste of Italy’s rustic Abruzzo region. Bold black fruit aromas mingle with wood smoke and tar layers, creating a smoky complexity that balances its fruit-forward character.  

This Montepulciano pairs beautifully with classic Italian dishes like Parma ham, sausage pizza, or beef bolognese, making it a versatile choice for hearty meals. Best served slightly below room temperature, this wine embodies the rugged charm of Abruzzo’s picturesque vineyards.

products.title: Estancia Mendoza Reserve Sparkling Brut Nature
products.description_html:
Experience the vibrant soul of Mendoza with Estancia Mendoza Sparkling Brut Nature, a dry and elegant bubbly crafted in the heart of the Uco Valley. 

Made with 70% Chardonnay and 30% Pinot Noir, this Brut Nature reveals a luminous golden hue with a whisper of pink. A lively tropical fruit and quince nose leads to a bright, crisp palate that’s both fresh and enveloping, thanks to its delicate and persistent bubbles. Made using the Charmat method, this wine undergoes fermentation in stainless steel to preserve its pristine character and expressive fruit aromas. 

Serve well chilled as a festive aperitif, or pair with seafood, sushi, or light vegetarian dishes.

products.title: 2019 Bambera Reserva Tempranillo
products.description_html:
Inspired by the starry skies of La Mancha, the 2019 Bambera Reserva Tempranillo shines as a true expression of traditional Spanish winemaking. Sourced from the historic vineyards of Valdepeñas, this Tempranillo-based blend undergoes meticulous aging—12 months in American oak barrels followed by an additional 2-3 years in the bottle—resulting in a deeply layered and refined wine. 

The intense cherry-red hue hints at the richness within, offering vanilla, dark chocolate, and ripe fruit aromas. On the palate, silky tannins and warming spice create a well-balanced structure, leading to a long, smooth finish. 

Perfectly versatile, pair this Bambera Reserva with grilled meats, Manchego cheese, or Spanish tapas for a truly authentic experience. Serve at 16-17°C for optimal enjoyment.

awards.competition: San Diego International Wine & Spirits Competition

products.title: 2022 Estancia Mendoza Reserve Cabernet Franc
products.description_html:
Sourced from the high-altitude vineyards of Central Valley, Mendoza, the 2022 Estancia Mendoza Cabernet Franc Reserve is a true expression of this noble grape. Its deep ruby-red color hints at the richness within, while its peppery aroma, eucalyptus lift, and spice-laced profile capture the wild beauty of Argentina’s terroir. 

Meticulously crafted from hand-harvested grapes and aged in French oak for 8 months, this Cabernet Franc is smooth with refined tannins and a beautifully lingering finish. The limited production—just over 1,000 bottles in the 2021 vintage—adds an exclusive charm to an already exceptional wine. 

Serve alongside grilled lamb chops, mushroom risotto, or herb-roasted vegetables for an unforgettable pairing.

products.title: 2024 Estancia Mendoza Reserve Torrontes
products.description_html:
From the foothills of the Andes at 1100 meters above sea level, the 2024 Estancia Mendoza Torrontes captures the essence of Argentine white wine. Known for its floral elegance and vibrant character, this Torrontes is made from 20-year-old vines and crafted with care. It is harvested by hand and fermented in stainless steel to preserve its crisp personality. 

This vintage opens with bright yellow hues and greenish highlights, bursting with citrus blossom and stone fruit notes. On the palate, it's lively and refreshing, perfectly balanced with zesty acidity and a clean, extended finish. 

Ideal as an aperitif or paired with sushi, ceviche, goat cheese, or a bright green salad. Chill, pour, and enjoy.

products.title: 2023 Ahlma Chardonnay Reserva
products.description_html:
The 2023 Ahlma Reserva Chardonnay embodies the essence of Chilean craftsmanship. It blends ripe tropical fruit with a touch of oak for a refined yet approachable white wine.  

Harvested from the renowned Maule Valley, this Chardonnay opens with an inviting pineapple and mango bouquet, elegantly interwoven with soft vanilla and toasted oak. 

The palate unfolds with baked apple and pear notes with a touch of butterscotch, offering a rich and creamy texture balanced by bright acidity. Barrel aging in a mix of first and second-use oak lends complexity and depth to every sip.  

Pair this elegant Chardonnay with roast chicken in a creamy lemon sauce or a buttery seafood dish.

products.title: 2022 Ahlma Syrah Reserva
products.description_html:
From the heart of Chile’s Central Valley, the 2022 Ahlma Syrah Reserva showcases the expertise of the Cremaschi family, whose winemaking heritage spans 130 years. Grown in stony alluvial soil at San Javier de Loncomilla, this Syrah benefits from the cooling influence of the Río Mataquito and Río Maule, preserving its vibrant acidity. 

Fermented in stainless steel tanks with gentle pump-overs, this ruby-hued Syrah delivers a fragrant nose of ripe red berries, violets, and wild herbs, complemented by hints of sour cherries and warm spices. The palate is well-structured, with ripe tannins, balanced persistence, and a smooth yet lasting finish. 

Pair this bold red with grilled lamb chops, venison, or a rich rabbit stew. Best served at 18°C to unlock its full aromatic potential.

What truly sets this wine apart is the gentle oak aging, which imparts delicate notes of vanilla and spice, enhancing every sip.

Pinot Noir Gran Reserva is the perfect companion for various dishes, from roasted duck and grilled salmon to mushroom risotto and soft cheeses.

Vinified with soft pressing and refined in stainless steel tanks, this wine maintains its freshness while developing a well-rounded, full-bodied taste.  

Its crisp acidity and silky texture make this Grillo a versatile pairing for grilled seafood, fresh pasta with clams, or a classic Caprese salad. Serve chilled at 9°C to fully enjoy its vibrant elegance.

products.title: 2024 House Party Moscato
products.description_html:
The 2024 House Party Moscato is a lively and refreshing white wine crafted for fun and festive moments. Made in the “New World” style, it offers a slightly drier take on traditional Moscato while maintaining the varietal’s signature fruit-forward charm. 

Orange blossom and citrus fruit notes lead into a palate bursting with juicy peach, ripe apricot, and a hint of tangerine. Delicate bubbles lift the flavors, creating a refreshingly smooth sip every time.  

Perfect as an aperitif, with light desserts like cheesecake and berry tarts, or alongside spicy Asian dishes for a delightful contrast.

reviews.title: Taste good
reviews.body: So sweet and good

products.title: Jenna Sweet Rosé
products.description_html:
Jenna Sweet Rosé California NV is a delightfully expressive wine, perfect for any gathering. Brimming with ripe strawberry, juicy raspberry, and delicate white flower notes, it offers a soft, honeyed peach finish that lingers on the palate. 

Crafted in the heart of California, this off-dry rosé balances sweetness with crisp acidity, making it an easy-drinking choice for warm afternoons, festive occasions, or casual sipping.  

Enjoy it chilled on its own or paired with fresh fruit, light appetizers, or spicy Asian cuisine.

reviews.title: Variety is the spice of life
reviews.body: A little sweeter than I usually like, but you need variety when entertaining. This is a good choice and I love the other Jenna wines!

products.title: 2023 Wild Gnu Chenin Blanc
products.description_html:
This fruit-driven white wine emits notes of pear drops, stone fruit, yellow apple, and hints of floral undertones. On the palate, this wine is dry with strong minerality and a crisp finish. The moderate to high acidity levels enhance its freshness, making it a perfect warm-weather sipper. 

The grapes of the Wild Gnu Chenin Blanc Stellenbosch 2023 are harvested in the early morning to preserve flavors and enhance the color of the wine. They are then destemmed, crushed, and left to settle overnight. The clean juice is inoculated with commercial wine yeast and fermented to perfection. Finally, the wine is racked off the lees before it is fined, filtered, and stabilized. 

Pair this bright, fruity, and tart wine with rich cheeses and dishes with both sweet and sour flavors. South Africa is the world’s leading Chenin Blanc producer, so when it comes to a sophisticated white from this varietal, you won’t be disappointed with this Wild Gnu.

reviews.title: Crisp and light
reviews.body: I love South African Chenin Blancs and this one is very good. Crisp and light.
