products.title: 2023 Cantina Etrusca Friulano D.O.C.
products.description_html:
The 2023 Cantina Etrusca Friulano embodies the refined elegance of Northern Italy’s Friuli region, where the clay-rich soils and cool climate shape wines of remarkable complexity. 

Harvested in September at an altitude of 250-300m, this Friulano undergoes soft pressing and controlled vinification in stainless steel tanks, preserving its crisp freshness. A pale-yellow hue introduces an aromatic white peach, dried hay, and fresh thyme bouquet. The palate is textured yet lively, revealing a mineral backbone that lingers through the finish. 

Enjoy this bright Italian white alongside fresh seafood, creamy risottos, or a classic prosciutto and melon pairing. Serve chilled at 10-12°C for optimal expression.

reviews.title: Absolutely refreshing and light!
reviews.body: Absolutely refreshing and light!

products.title: 2023 Famiglia Peraccini Merlot
products.description_html:
Indulge in the brilliance of Famiglia Peraccini Merlot Veneto Italy 2023—a wine that beautifully showcases the character of Veneto's clay and gravel soils. This brilliant ruby red wine opens with a vinous aroma of raspberry, cherry, spices, and a delicate herbaceous flavor. 

The grapes are softly pressed and undergo fermentation in stainless steel tanks with selected yeasts for about 8 days in contact with the skins, all at a controlled temperature of 18 degrees Celsius. The result is a wine with a well-structured, rounded finish and moderate tannins that add to its deliciousness.

Pair with roast duck, lean beef, and spaghetti doused in herbaceous tomato sauce.

products.title: 2023 Montañero Private Reserve Cabernet Sauvignon
products.description_html:
Introducing Montañero Reserva Cabernet Sauvignon Maule Valley Chile 2023. This deep ruby red wine is crafted from hand-harvested Cabernet Sauvignon grapes grown under the blazing sun during the day and coastal night winds. 

The vineyards in Chile's central zone boast moderately fertile granitic-clay soils. This Cabernet Sauvignon matures for 6 months in American and French oak barrels. 

On the nose, it entices with notes of ripe plums and toasted hazelnuts, while the palate offers intense and juicy tannins, culminating in a satisfying finish. Pair it with red meats, pasta dishes featuring Bolognese sauce, or aged cheeses for an exquisite culinary experience. Serve at 16º–18°C and savor the essence of Maule Valley's winemaking excellence.

products.title: 2023 Cantina Etrusca Montepulciano d'Abruzzo D.O.C.
products.description_html:
The 2023 Cantina Etrusca Montepulciano d'Abruzzo celebrates the robust winemaking tradition of eastern Italy. With its intense ruby hue and wild cherry notes, this wine showcases the vibrancy of Montepulciano grapes grown in clay and gravel soils. 

Aging in steel tanks preserves the wine’s freshness, while velvety tannins and a smooth finish make it versatile for pairing. Enjoy with tomato-based pasta, margarita pizza, or grilled meats. Serve slightly below room temperature for optimal flavor.

reviews.title: Great for the price!
reviews.body: This is a fine wine for the price! Better day two (or decanted?), it is rich and flavorful and drinks like a much more expensive wine. Top notch!

reviews.title: Buy me!!
reviews.body: If you love Italy, buy this!!

products.title: 2022 Pajarito White Blend
products.description_html:
The 2022 Pajarito White Blend combines Sauvignon Blanc's brightness with Riesling's elegance for a truly refreshing experience. Pale yellow with golden reflections, it reveals green apple and citrus aromas with a touch of honey. 

This versatile blend pairs beautifully with Asian cuisine, soft cheeses, or seafood. Its bright acidity and subtle minerality make it a delightful addition to any meal. Serve chilled at 12°C to enhance its crisp, refreshing character.

products.title: 2023 Arenas Moscato
products.description_html:
The 2023 Arenas Moscato is a delightful Chilean sparkler with sweet floral and fruity charm. Orange blossom and honeysuckle notes blend harmoniously with ripe peach and green grape flavors, elevated by a delicate cascade of bubbles. 

This low-alcohol Moscato is ideal for celebratory moments. It is perfect as an aperitif or paired with light salads, seafood, or creamy desserts. Serve well-chilled for maximum refreshment.

products.title: 2023 Pierofosco Sangiovese di Toscana I.G.T.
products.description_html:
Explore plump and approachable flavor with 2023 Pierofosco Sangiovese di Toscana I.G.T., a dry, fruit-forward red wine from Tuscany, Italy.  

Intensely red in the glass, this classic Sangiovese brims with aromas of tangy cherry met with savory bacon. Pleasantly fruity and well-balanced, the palate exhibits juicy flavor notes of dark fruit and plums, underscored by rounded tannins for a long and pleasing finish. 

Tuscany’s signature red grape, Sangiovese is one of the most widely planted varieties in all of Italy. Prized for its high acid, balanced character, and sturdy nature, it has become a key ingredient in modern blends known as “Super Tuscans.” 

Best served slightly chilled, 2023 Pierofosco Sangiovese di Toscana I.G.T. is great for sipping on its own and pairs well with a variety of foods. Because of its generous tannins, this wine makes a great companion for rich dishes like braised pork ragu, lamb chops, cured sausages, and hard cheeses.

products.title: 2023 Cantina Etrusca Rosato di Toscana IGT
products.description_html:
The 2023 Cantina Etrusca Rosato Toscana embodies the elegance of Italy’s rosé tradition. Made from hand-harvested grapes with short skin maceration, this delicate pink wine is aged in stainless steel to preserve its freshness. 

Bright citrus and floral aromas lead into a refreshingly crisp palate with grapefruit zest and rose petal undertones. Its fresh and persistent finish makes it a perfect match for seafood, grilled vegetables, or light pastas.

reviews.title: Quite good. Try it!
reviews.body: I haven't had many Rose wines in the past but his one was very good.  Crisp with a nice finish.  I order a single bottle to try and thoroughly enjoyed it.  In fact on my second order I bought 8 more bottles.  Six for us and 2 for our grown daughter

images.alt: 2023 Cantina Etrusca Rosato di Toscana IGT

products.title: 2022 Alquira Reserva Red Blend
products.description_html:
The 2022 Alquira Red Blend Reserva combines 60% Cabernet Sauvignon, 30% Carménère, and 10% Cabernet Franc for a rich and balanced experience. With a deep ruby hue, this blend offers vibrant blackberry and plum aromas, underscored by herbal notes. 

Crafted sustainably in Chile’s Central Valley, the wine’s velvety tannins and smooth finish make it an excellent partner for grilled meats, robust stews, or aged cheeses. Serve slightly cool for optimal enjoyment.

reviews.title: Another affordable but good option
reviews.body: Love the taste, definitely good grapes

products.title: 2023 Pian de Poggio Pinot Grigio D.O.C.
products.description_html:
The 2023 Pian del Poggio Pinot Grigio is an elegant expression of Italy’s renowned Delle Venezie region. Grown in sandstone-rich soils at elevations of 250-300 meters, this wine is crafted with precision, undergoing a soft pressing and stainless-steel fermentation to preserve its crisp character. 

Delicate white plum, citrus, and green apple aromas lead to a dry, mineral-driven finish, making this wine a perfect companion to light seafood dishes, fresh salads, or creamy pasta primavera. Serve chilled for a truly refreshing experience.

reviews.title: Beautiful bouquet perfect...
reviews.body: Beautiful bouquet perfect summer wine!

images.alt: 2023 Pian de Poggio Pinot Grigio D.O.C.

products.title: 2024 Modernist Dry Riesling
products.description_html:
Hailing from the rolling hills of Western Germany, 2024 Modernist Dry Riesling is a contemporary take on one of the world’s most versatile varieties. Boasting a vibrant, Bauhaus-inspired label, this wine is designed to stand out.  

Made from 100% Riesling grapes, it opens with delicate aromas of white peaches, apricots, and juicy pears. The palate is expressive, with spicy and salty tasting notes that segue into a smooth, lasting finish.  

As a wine region, Germany is most known for producing world-class Rieslings. The winemakers behind Modernist are precise in their craft, taking environmentally friendly steps (like using natural fertilizer and reducing carbon emissions) while increasing quality of the grapes. 

Make a statement at your next party by bringing a bottle of Modernist Riesling. Refreshing as an aperitif, this wine lends itself nicely to shrimp cocktail, oven-roasted crispy pork belly, lightly-pickled vegetables, and sushi.

products.title: 2023 L'Odalet Marsanne-Roussanne IGP
products.description_html:
This exquisite blend of Marsanne and Roussanne is a true reflection of the Pays d’Oc terroir. Harvested early to preserve its vibrant aromas, the wine undergoes stainless steel fermentation to enhance its fresh, fruit-forward profile. 

Golden in hue with hints of green, it opens with apricot, ripe pear, and peach aromas, followed by a smooth palate of citrus and delicate florals. Pair it with creamy seafood dishes, white meats, or as an aperitif for a taste of French luxury.

products.title: 2022 Poggio Manfredi Toscana Rosso I.G.T. 1.5L
products.description_html:
This 2022 Poggio Manfredi Toscana Rosso is a bold and delicious red blend from the Tuscany IGT. Expect well-balanced flavors and aromas of red fruit, along with a savory and spicy note. 

Made from a blend of 50% Merlot and 50% Sangiovese, this wine is known as a “Super Tuscan,” in which international grapes (Merlot) are blended with grapes native to the region (Sangiovese). This helps balance the wine’s flavors between the fruit notes of Merlot and the intensely savory characteristics of Sangiovese. In addition, this wine was aged in oak for 20 months and in the bottle for 4 months, helping to soften the flavors and increase richness. 

Pair our Poggio Manfredi Toscana Rosso with medium-to-rich dishes such as lamb, pork, or pasta with mushroom sauce.

products.title: 2024 Süßen Riesling
products.description_html:
From Rheinhessen, Germany’s largest wine region, 2024 Süßen Riesling is an off-dry white  that’s a beautiful expression of the ever-versatile variety.  

Opening with a classically elegant bouquet, this wine displays fragrant orchard and tropical fruit aromas. On the palate, bright flavor notes of green apple, citrus, pineapple, and melon are met with refreshing acidity. 

Originally from Germany, Riesling is the country's most popular variety. The winemakers behind Süßen are precise in their craft, taking environmentally friendly steps (like using natural fertilizer and reducing carbon emissions) while increasing quality of the grapes. 

Sweet yet zingy, this Süßen Riesling offers a lively and engaging sipping experience. Enjoy with flavorful foods like spicy Thai noodles, creamy fish chowder, crab cakes, and seasonal salads with goat cheese.

products.title: Puraclasse Sparkling Moscato Rosé Dolce
products.description_html:
The Purclasse Sparkling Moscato Rosé Dolce is a lively Italian sparkling wine that brings a spirit of celebration to any occasion. Its bright pink hue and fine bubbles set the stage for a delightful tasting experience.  

Candied strawberry, peach, and apricot flavors blend with cherry licorice and bubblegum undertones, creating a sweet yet balanced profile.  

This wine is also ideal for casual sipping and is perfect for pairing with light desserts like raspberry tarts or fruit platters. Serve chilled to enjoy its effervescent and festive character.

products.title: 2023 Lone Cardinal Pinot Noir
products.description_html:
Dive into soft fruit flavors with an earthy finish.

The nose of this 2023 Lone Cardinal Pinot Noir exhibits bright aromas of black cherry, juicy raspberry, and dried cherry blossoms. Dig a little deeper, and you’ll find that the bouquet opens up to spiced layers of nutmeg, cinnamon, and light cloves. Tannins are light and supple, perfectly matching the earthy finish of tobacco, oak, and wild mushroom. 

Lone Cardinal’s mission is to craft wines that embody the carefree spirit of California wine country, as embodied by this light and supple Pinot. While the golden state is often known for its teeming vineyards of Chardonnay and Cabernet Sauvignon, the radiant, sunny days and cool, relaxed nights also make the perfect breeding ground for exceptional Pinot grapes. The high temperatures impart refreshing acidity and a delicious burst of jammy fruit, creating a glass that’s truly greater than the sum of its parts.

Due to its fruity nose and light body, this 2023 Californian Pinot is an incredibly versatile pairing wine. We recommend pouring yourself a glass the next time you enjoy braised duck and shallots, bacon and onion pizza, or a simple grilled chicken club sandwich.

products.title: Almena Sparkling Brut Rosé
products.description_html:
Almena Sparkling Brut Rosé is a lively and refreshing Spanish wine crafted from Garnacha grapes. Pale pink with fine bubbles, it captivates ripe red fruit aromas like strawberries and redcurrants. The creamy texture and balanced acidity make each sip a delightfully refreshing experience. 

This sparkling wine is crafted precisely using the Charmat method, delivering vibrant flavors and natural effervescence. 

Serve very chilled at around 4ºC as an aperitif or alongside seafood, rice dishes, or light Mediterranean fare for a festive pairing.

products.title: Abbazia La Tartaruga Moscato Provincia di Pavia I.G.T.
products.description_html:
Sit back and enjoy a Moscato that will transport you to  the Mediterranean.
 
European mountain air and Mediterranean ocean breezes combine on the Abbazia family winery, where this tasty Moscato heralds from. This wine is a sweet treat for anyone, floating delectable flavors of honey and peach over the light body and satin texture of the wine. The Abbazia Moscato Pavia is a drink for indulging your sweet tooth. 
 
Drink this wine all on its own, or pair with a light dessert.

images.alt: Abbazia La Tartaruga Moscato Provincia di Pavia I.G.T.

products.title: 2022 Vega Demara Tempranillo Joven
products.description_html:
The 2022 Vega Demara Tempranillo Joven is a youthful and energetic red wine from Spain’s La Mancha region. Deep cherry in color with violet hints, it delivers vibrant strawberry and cherry aromas with subtle floral notes. On the palate, it is well-structured with balanced tannins and a fruity finish, making it perfect for casual dining.  

Pair it with burgers, pizza, pasta, or appetizers, and chill slightly to enhance its fresh and fruity flavor.

products.title: 2023 Estancia Mendoza Reserve Cabernet Sauvignon Magnum
products.description_html:
Unearth the essence of Uco Valley's northern region with our 100% Cabernet Sauvignon. Hand-harvested at 1100 meters above sea level from 20-year-old vines every March, this wine undergoes meticulous winemaking, including destemming, controlled-temperature fermentation, and natural malolactic fermentation. 

Aged for 6 months in second-use American oak barrels and 4 months in the bottle before release, it boasts a bright ruby-red hue with spicy and herbaceous notes. The palate offers an intense, friendly entry, full-bodied character, and a delicate, complex finish. With previous vintages having won several gold and silver awards, savor Mendoza's authentic flavors with Estancia Mendoza's Reserve Cabernet Sauvignon.

Pair this Oaked Cabernet with blue cheese burgers, filet mignon, and prime rib.

images.alt: 2023 Estancia Mendoza Reserve Cabernet Sauvignon Magnum

products.title: 2023 Granietkop Red Blend
products.description_html:
Crafted by fourth-generation winemaker Stephan Basson at Babylon’s Peak, the 2023 Granietkop Red Blend is a stunning example of Swartland’s bold yet balanced reds. This expertly crafted blend—Shiraz (70%), Mourvèdre (20%), and Viognier (10%)—is matured in older barrels for eight months, allowing the flavors to integrate beautifully. 

Rich dark fruit and violet aromas intertwine with a touch of white pepper, leading to a well-balanced, fruit-driven palate with smooth, lingering tannins. Enjoy this versatile red on its own or paired with oxtail, venison, or ostrich for an authentic South African experience.

products.title: McGregor Sparkling Brut Rosé
products.description_html:
The 2024 McGregor Sparkling Brut Rosé is the ultimate warm-weather refreshment. Made from early-harvested Muscat grapes, this lively rosé achieves its delicate salmon-pink hue through limited skin contact, enhancing its floral and fruity character. 

Turkish delight aromas lead into a zesty burst of lemon and fresh strawberries, complemented by elegant bubbles and a crisp, refreshing finish. Perfect for brunch, this sparkling Rosé pairs wonderfully with flapjacks topped with crème fraîche and strawberry compote.

products.title: 2024 Granietkop Chenin Blanc/Roussanne
products.description_html:
From the heart of Swartland, the 2024 Granietkop Chenin Blanc/Roussanne is a tribute to the region’s winemaking legacy. Crafted by Babylon’s Peak, this blend—95% Chenin Blanc and 5% Roussanne—offers a refreshing and fruit-forward profile with a beautifully crisp finish. 

Vibrant dried pear and apricot aromas lead into a lively, well-structured palate with bright acidity and a touch of citrus. This dry white wine is a perfect match for fresh salads, seafood, or grilled chicken dishes, making it an ideal choice for warm-weather sipping.

products.title: 2021 Beni Duilio Castellani Riserva Chianti DOCG
products.description_html:
Our Beni Duilio Castellani Chianti Riserva DOCG 2021 is a traditional Tuscan red wine made from Sangiovese and other red grape varieties. It is bright ruby red with a tendency to garnet.

The bouquet is intense and characteristic, with fruity and violet fragrances. On the palate, it is dry and harmonious, with velvety notes of black cherries and smooth tannins. 

This robust red wine is ideal for pairing with grilled meat and pasta dishes with rich tomato sauce.

products.title: Bottles for Brunch
products.description_html: Wake up to the perfect brunch pairing with the Bottles for Brunch pack. Featuring a vibrant Spanish Rosé, a crisp South African Chenin Blanc, and a sophisticated sparkling wine from Italy, this collection is made for leisurely mornings and indulgent afternoons. Whether you’re serving up fluffy pancakes, creamy egg dishes, or smoked salmon platters, these wines will elevate every bite with their fresh fruit flavors, bright acidity, and touch of floral effervescence.

products.title: Dabalia by Vega Demara Sparkling Brut
products.description_html:
The Dabalia Sparkling Brut by Vega Demara is a refined sparkling wine from La Mancha, Spain. Pale yellow with fine, persistent bubbles delights with peach, apricot, and apple aromas. On the palate, its vibrant acidity and fresh finish make it a perfect choice for toasting at parties or as an aperitif.  

Pair this sparkling wine with smoked salmon, seafood, or light desserts for an elegant dining experience. Serve well-chilled to bring out its refreshing and sophisticated character.

images.alt: Dabalia by Vega Demara Sparkling Brut

products.title: 2023 Vega Demara Verdejo
products.description_html:
The 2023 Vega Demara Verdejo is a bright and refreshing wine from La Mancha, Spain. Intense peach and apricot aromas are complemented by almond and anise undertones, creating a complex yet approachable profile.  

Medium-bodied with vibrant acidity, this Verdejo finishes with a fresh, elegant crispness. It is ideal for pairing with seafood, salads, soft cheeses, or light pasta dishes. Serve chilled to fully enjoy its lively and aromatic character, showcasing the best Spanish white wines.

products.title: 2023 Cantina Etrusca Frappato
products.description_html:
Transport yourself to the sun-kissed vineyards of Sicily with the 2023 Cantina Etrusca Frappato, an expressive and aromatic red wine. Grown in clay and sandy soils, this vibrant Frappato showcases a ruby-red hue with an inviting bouquet of candied violets, smoky tones, and red fruit. 

Aged in stainless steel tanks and refined in bottles, this wine balances freshness with complexity, offering balsamic notes and subtle spices that linger on the palate. The finish is long and elegant, making it a delightful companion for Mediterranean dishes, grilled vegetables, or a classic margherita pizza.

products.title: M. Pelletier Vin Mousseux Blanc de Blancs
products.description_html:
A sparkling wine with freshness and a fine bubble, M. Pelletier Sparkling Blanc de Blancs is delightful and refreshing.

M. Pelletier Sparkling Blanc de Blancs carries a bouquet of white and yellow fruits that’s followed by an elegant touch of florals. This wine is complex yet traditional and fizzy on the palate.

The vines grown in clay-limestone soils are harvested early to retain the freshness and characteristics suitable for sparkling wines. ​​After pressing, settling, and cold stabilization, fermentation is done at low temperatures to avoid any tartaric precipitation.

Enjoy this bubbly blanc during any celebration. Appropriate food pairings include fried potatoes and onions or juicy steaks and salmon.

products.title: Almena Sparkling Brut
products.description_html:
Almena Sparkling Brut showcases the brilliance of Spanish sparkling wines. Made from Macabeo and Chardonnay grapes, this wine sparkles with bright yellow hues, citrus and white fruit aromas, with a touch of baked cakes. Its fresh and crisp palate is complemented by a creamy texture, offering a luxurious experience with every sip. 

This wine is expertly crafted using the Charmat method to achieve its lively bubbles and balanced flavors. 

Serve well-chilled at around 4ºC as an aperitif, or pair with fish, seafood, or rice dishes for a refined culinary match.

products.title: 2022 Vespertine Merlot
products.description_html:
The black cherry hues of this 2022 Vespertine Merlot promise a nose of complex fruit and creamy dark chocolate.

The palate opens with punchy notes of plum balanced by hints of cherry and toasted spice. The Merlot is pleasantly dry with a medium to full body and robust tannins. The finish is smooth, long, and lingering with subtle notes of blackberry.

This 2022 Merlot by Vespertine is cultivated in the Lodi region of Northern California, just 90 miles outside San Francisco. This historically rich farming area has moderate summers, cooled by the Sacramento Delta and blessed with ancient vines for grape growth. 

While this Vespertine Merlot is undoubtedly more than enough when sipped on its own, it can bring the best out of truly rich meat dishes such as filet mignon, a juicy medium-rare burger, or a rack of roasted lamb.

The 2023 Fauno Red Blend combines Grenache, Shiraz, and Monastrell for a full-bodied, fruit-forward red wine that captures the warmth of Spain’s Mediterranean vineyards. With its deep red hue and red fruit, blackberry, and floral violet aromas, this wine is as inviting as it is complex. 

Aged with a touch of American oak, it delivers a harmonious balance of ripe fruit and spice, making it an excellent choice for red meats, spicy dishes, or goat cheeses. Serve slightly chilled to enhance its vibrant flavors and structured tannins.

products.title: 2022 Pioneer Town Malbec
products.description_html:
The 2022 Pioneer Town Malbec captures the essence of California’s cooler vineyards, crafting a wine that balances vibrancy with elegance. Violet, blackberry, and black cherry aromas rise from the glass, enriched by a hint of cocoa powder and peppery spice. On the palate, juicy tart plum, cranberry, and boysenberry flavors intermingle with earthy undertones and a streak of minerality. 

The wine’s higher natural acidity and fine-grained tannins provide a structured, refreshing mouthfeel, while its deep ruby hue and violet reflections hint at its youthful vibrancy. Medium-bodied with a lingering finish, this Malbec is a testament to cool-climate winemaking. 

Pair it with grilled vegetables, roasted duck, or dishes featuring smoky or herbal flavors to complement its earthy and fruit-forward profile.

products.title: 2023 Sous L'Ocean Bordeaux Blanc
products.description_html:
Sip a wine that’s as fresh as the sea breeze with 2023 Sous L'Ocean Organic Bordeaux Blanc by EthicDrinks. Made from organic Sauvignon Blanc grapes grown in Bordeaux, France, this dry white wine is as good in the glass as it is good for the Earth.   

The nose reveals lively citrus and exotic fruits with hints of flowers. Crisp apple and lemon meet juicy passionfruit, balanced out by vibrant acidity to create an elegant, approachable pour. Medium-bodied with a long finish, this white wine is wonderfully refreshing.   

Hailing from one of the world’s most renowned wine regions, this Sauvignon Blanc represents the lighter, fruitier style of Bordeaux whites. While the region’s reds often take center stage, the rarer whites are just as impressive, and this one lets Sauvignon Blanc shine on its own. Certified organic grapes were nurtured in vineyards in Bordeaux, where the beloved white variety was born.   

This wine is part of the Sous L’Ocean line from EthicDrinks. Sous L’Ocean is inspired by efforts to help marine mammals and endangered species, reflecting EthicDrinks’ passion for protecting the planet and making the world of wine more environmentally friendly. Based in Bordeaux, EthicDrinks offers fresh, fruity wines from vine-growers that incorporate eco-conscious practices in winemaking.   

This bottle is free of plastic, made from recycled or natural materials, and is 100% recyclable. As a certified B Corporation, EthicDrinks is committed to social and environmental responsibility and using business as a power for good. Beyond sharing quality wines, EthicDrinks partners with conservation-focused organizations like The World Wide Fund for Nature France (WWF France). 

Best served chilled, 2023 Sous L'Ocean Organic Bordeaux Blanc by EthicDrinks is delicious with light appetizers and coastal cuisine. It pairs well to fresh salads, risotto with green veggies, pasta with pesto, and white fish like halibut.

reviews.body: Enjoyed it and my guest enjoyed as well.

reviews.body: Really enjoyed this wine! It has a fresh, vibrant flavor with notes of citrus and a clean finish. Light, refreshing, and pairs beautifully with seafood or light meals. Highly recommended.

products.title: 2023 Fat Rooster Chardonnay
products.description_html:
The 2023 Fat Rooster Chardonnay delivers a bright and balanced experience from the Setúbal Peninsula. This limpid citric-colored white wine boasts yellow plum and nectarine aromas, while the palate reveals ripe apple, yellow peach, and a subtle hint of buttery toast. The long, mineral-tinged finish ensures a satisfying sip every time. 

Harvested in early September and fermented in stainless steel vats at controlled temperatures, this wine showcases Portuguese Chardonnay's rich complexity and freshness. 

Pair it with vegetarian dishes, citrus-roasted chicken, creamy pasta, or shellfish to bring out its vibrant flavors.

products.title: 2023 Valdemacuco Blanco
products.description_html:
The 2023 Valdemacuco Blanco Rioja is a captivating Spanish white wine with a pale yellow hue and greenish highlights. Pear, citrus, and white flower aromas lead to a smooth, fresh palate with perfectly balanced acidity. 

Blended from Viura, Malvasía, and Tempranillo Blanco, this wine pairs wonderfully with grilled fish, shellfish, or light pasta dishes. Serve chilled for a delightful tasting experience.

products.title: 2023 Valdemacuco Rosé
products.description_html:
The 2023 Valdemacuco Rosé Rioja enchants with its pale rose hue and vibrant floral bouquet. Strawberry and rose water notes paired with a silky mouthfeel, and a fresh, floral finish complement wild raspberry flavors. 

Crafted from Garnacha and Viura, this rosé perfectly matches Mediterranean cuisine like rice dishes, creamy salads, or grilled fish. Serve chilled at 6-8°C for an unforgettable sipping experience.

products.title: 2023 Vinha Redonda Vinho Branco
products.description_html:
Vinha Redonda White Blend 2024 captures the freshness and elegance of Portugal’s Setúbal Peninsula. This citrine-colored wine delights with aromatic floral notes and soft citrus flavors, leading to a smooth and lingering finish. 

Crafted from Fernão Pires, Moscatel Graúdo, and Antão Vaz grapes, this white blend is fermented in stainless steel to maintain its bright and fresh profile. 

Perfect for warm days, pair it with seafood, light salads, or white meats.

reviews.title: White Wine was mellow
reviews.body: The white was much better and preferred this over the other selections in this shipment

products.title: 2023 Valdemacuco Tempranillo
products.description_html:
The 2023 Valdemacuco Tempranillo offers a vibrant cherry-red hue with purple reflections, setting the stage for its rich, fruity profile. Blackberry and blueberry aromas dominate the nose, while the palate boasts a smooth entry and round texture. 

Hand-harvested in Spain’s Rioja region, this Tempranillo pairs seamlessly with grilled meats, charcuterie, or classic paellas. Serve slightly chilled for a refreshing twist on this bold red.

reviews.title: Big red
reviews.body: Rich flavor like a good California red.

products.title: 2023 Wirbel Grüner Veltliner
products.description_html:
The 2023 Wirbel Grüner Veltliner offers a vibrant taste of the famed Lower Austria region. Green apple and zesty citrus aromas are accented by white pepper and a subtle herbal touch, creating a lively and refreshing profile. 

Crafted from the varied soils of Niederösterreich, this Grüner Veltliner reflects its excellent climate origins with crisp acidity and mineral elegance. Enjoy it with light dishes like salads and seafood or simply as a refreshing aperitif.

reviews.title: My favorite white
reviews.body: I love this wine. It has a lot of minerality and is great for day to day drinking.

products.title: 2023 Montañero Private Reserve Carménère
products.description_html:
Delight in the elegance of the 2023 Montañero Reserve Carménère, a wine that embodies the rich winemaking heritage of Chile’s Maule Valley. From the first sip, this dry, medium-bodied red enchants with black plum and black pepper aromas with a hint of tobacco. Its complex palate reveals layers of ripe blackberry and plum, complemented by earthy herbal notes and smooth, velvety tannins. 

This Carménère reflects the unique terroir of Maule Valley, where sun-soaked days, cool nights, and maritime influences allow the grapes to ripen slowly. Aged in American and French oak barrels for six months, this wine boasts structure and finesse. 

Perfect for pairing with red meats, pasta in tomato-based sauces, or soft cheeses, Montañero Reserve also shines alongside pepper-seasoned dishes that enhance its subtle spice. Serve at 60–64°F for the best experience.

products.title: 2023 Les Baies Fleuries Gamay
products.description_html:
Les Baies Fleuries Gamay 2023 is a lively red wine embodying youth's exuberance. Its deep purple and garnet body opens with blackberry, blueberry, and spice aromas. The palate is round and balanced, offering a pleasant sweetness and a fresh, elegant finish. 

Crafted from 100% Gamay grapes grown in southern France, this wine is best enjoyed lightly chilled. Its refreshing and approachable nature makes it perfect for pairing with charcuterie, parsley ham, or creamy cheeses like Brillat-Savarin.

products.title: Granite Ridge Red Blend
products.description_html:
The Granite Ridge Red Blend brings the soul of South Africa’s Western Cape right to your glass. Crafted from Swartland’s exclusively selected old bush vines, this wine perfectly captures its terroir’s essence and the skilled hands that nurture it. A harmonious Syrah, Grenache, and Cinsault blend, the varietals are co-fermented for seamless flavor integration, showcasing a dark berry bouquet intertwined with fynbos herbs and warm spices.

After 18 months of barrel aging, the wine develops a smooth, refined texture that is complex yet approachable. The primary lees enhance depth without the need for additional sulfur. The result is a fresh, balanced wine with bright acidity and lower alcohol, making it an ideal choice for those seeking elegance in every sip.

Pair it with grilled lamb chops, hearty stews, or a rich mushroom risotto for an unforgettable dining experience.

products.title: 2023 Tercius Vinho Tinto Tejo
products.description_html:
The 2023 Tercius Red Blend brings the lush flavors of Portugal’s Tejo region to your glass. This vibrant red wine boasts a crystal-clear ruby hue and enticing ripe fruit and compote aromas. Its palate is smooth yet structured, with soft tannins providing balance and a lasting, pleasant finish. 

Crafted from hand-picked Castelão, Aragonês, Trincadeira, and Touriga Nacional grapes, the wine is fermented at controlled temperatures to preserve its bright fruit character and harmonious structure. 

Enjoy Tercius Red Blend alongside grilled meats, hearty stews, or aged cheeses for a perfect pairing.

products.title: 2023 Tercius Vinho Branco Tejo
products.description_html:
The 2023 Tercius White Blend offers a taste of Portugal’s sun-drenched Tejo region with its vibrant tropical flavors and floral elegance. Crystal clear with a hint of citrus, this wine opens with pineapple, mango, and delicate rose aromas. Its soft freshness and well-balanced profile lead to a perfumed, lingering finish. 

Made from Trincadeira das Pratas, Fernão Pires, and Arinto grapes, this wine is carefully fermented at controlled temperatures to preserve its aromatic complexity and fresh character. 

Serve chilled with grilled seafood, creamy pasta, or light salads for a delightful pairing.

products.title: 2023 Montañero Private Reserve Red Blend
products.description_html:
Experience the symphony of flavors in our Montañero Reserva Red Blend, a blend of 50% Carménère and 50% Syrah. Born from vineyards in Chile's central zone, this wine exhibits a deep purplish-red color and enticing aromas of ripe red fruits, spices, and toasted hazelnuts. 

Its intense and well-balanced palate with velvety tannins makes it an ideal companion for grilled red meats, pasta with tomato-based sauces, and aged cheeses. Serve it at 16º–18°C and immerse yourself in the richness of Maule Valley's terroir.

products.title: 2022 Casa Roja Tinto Rojo
products.description_html:
The 2022 Casa Roja Tinto Rojo captures Spain’s sunny vineyards in a bottle. Aged in American oak barrels for five months, this garnet-colored wine delivers ripe fruit aromas complemented by soft vanilla and caramel undertones. Its balanced tannins and round, smooth body create a versatile profile that finishes with a subtle sweetness.  

Perfect for pairing with pasta, barbecued meats, or grilled vegetables, this wine elevates both casual and formal meals.

products.title: 2022 Flor de Sara Vendimia Seleccionada Red Blend Rioja
products.description_html:
The 2022 Flor de Sara Vendimia Seleccionada Red Blend is a vibrant expression of Rioja’s renowned winemaking heritage. Dominated by Tempranillo, this wine boasts cherry, cranberry, and baking spice aromas, complemented by coconut and dill undertones. Aged in American oak for six months, it delivers a juicy, fresh finish with balanced acidity.  

Perfect for casual meals like roast chicken, pork chops, pizza, or burgers, this versatile red is an excellent choice for everyday enjoyment and milestone celebrations.

images.alt: 2022 Flor de Sara Vendimia Seleccionada Red Blend Rioja

products.title: 2023 Flor de Sara Viura Rioja D.O.Ca.
products.description_html:
Like blooming flowers in springtime, the 2023 Flor de Sara Viura is a soft, aromatic wine from the Rioja growing region of Spain. 
 
Cold Atlantic winds clash with warm Mediterranean breezes to give the grapes of this region deep and complex flavors that are difficult to replicate anywhere else. As a wine intended to be enjoyed young, the Flor de Sara Viura is exceedingly versatile, toeing the line between casual and refined. 
 
Pair this delightful varietal with chicken or seafood meals or bring out the bottle for appetizers of soft cheese and vegetables.

awards.competition: San Diego International Wine & Spirits Competition

products.title: Tesoro Vite Sparkling Brut
products.description_html:
The Tesoro Vite Sparkling Brut is a sophisticated expression of Italian winemaking, crafted from Glera and Chardonnay grapes grown in the marl and clay-rich soils of high-altitude vineyards. Its fine perlage enhances the wine's elegant character, while the nose bursts with intense green apple and delicate citrus notes. On the palate, its soft sweetness and fresh acidity strike a harmonious balance. 

Using the traditional Charmat method, the wine undergoes a 40-day secondary fermentation in stainless steel tanks, ensuring the preservation of its lively effervescence and vibrant flavors.  

Perfect for pairing with light seafood dishes, creamy pastas, or fresh fruit platters, this sparkling wine is also an ideal aperitif. Serve chilled at 8°C to fully enjoy its crisp and refreshing profile.

reviews.title: Ver good sparkling wine
reviews.body: This sparkling brut wine was very good. Just the right amount of bubbles and a very nice flavor

products.title: 2020 Château Augère Cuvee Vieilles Vignes Bordeaux Supérieur
products.description_html:
The 2020 Chateau Augere Cuvee Vieilles Vignes Bordeaux Supérieur is an elegant French red crafted from Bordeaux’s old vine grapes. Bursting with black currant and ripe plum notes, warm spices, and smooth vanilla undertones enrich this wine's profile.  

Aged in French oak, it boasts velvety tannins and a long, refined finish that pairs wonderfully with roasted meats, hearty stews, or aged cheeses. Whether enjoyed during a special dinner or a quiet evening at home, this Bordeaux Supérieur exemplifies the timeless sophistication of French winemaking.

products.title: 2019 Pavillon La Tourelle Bordeaux Supérieur Rouge Magnum
products.description_html:
The red Bordeaux Superieur is characterized by aromatic complexity combining ripe fruits, floral aromas, spice, and a hint of oak. Its grapes are grown in the limestone soils of Bordeaux’s “high country” and then hand-selected according to rigorous criteria to ensure their quality. Throughout its turbulent history, invaders strived to control the Gironde estuary where the wine’s magnificent grapes are grown. 

After the grapes are destemmed and crushed, the wine is fermented and aged in oak barrels, giving it that distinguished, well-rounded structure. With an intense garnet hue, this Bordeaux blend is crafted with Cabernet Sauvignon and Merlot grapes. This forms a pleasant bouquet of black fruit, blackberry, and morello cherry with undertones of spice, smoke, nutmeg, and cocoa. The tannins of this red blend are fine and well-balanced. 

Pair this esteemed Bordeaux blend with smoked red meat and hearty pasta with a tomato-based sauce.

products.title: 2023 Les Chartrons Bordeaux Blanc
products.description_html:
The 2023 Les Chartrons Bordeaux Blanc is a beautiful representation of Bordeaux’s white winemaking traditions. Composed of 60% Sémillon and 40% Sauvignon Blanc, this wine dazzles with its pale-yellow hue and shimmering green reflections. Yellow fruit and floral notes fill the glass, while the palate offers a lively, fresh finish.  

Perfect for pairing with soft cheeses or delicately prepared fish dishes, this classic Bordeaux Blanc adds sophistication to any meal. Whether enjoyed with traditional French cuisine or alone, this wine is a delightful expression of Bordeaux’s rich winemaking heritage.

reviews.title: We loved it!

products.title: 2023 Mount Rozier Reserve "Fire Pit" Cabernet Sauvignon
products.description_html:
The 2023 Mount Rozier Reserve 'Firepit' Cabernet Sauvignon is a rich, smoky red wine crafted in the scenic vineyards of South Africa’s Western Cape. This full-bodied wine opens with deep black currant and cherry aromas, enhanced by subtle dark chocolate and spiced oak notes.

Sourced from southeast-facing slopes and grown in granite soils, the grapes for this Cabernet Sauvignon are hand-selected for their concentration and flavor depth. Oak aging further adds complexity, imparting a delightful smoky finish that pairs well with grilled meats or rich vegetable dishes like stuffed mushrooms.

Perfect for enjoying around the firepit, this wine is ideal for pairing with beef tagliata, lamb skewers, or a savory veggie dish like braised red cabbage.

products.title: 2023 Mount Rozier Reserve "Stable Yard" Shiraz
products.description_html:
The 2023 Mount Rozier Reserve ‘Stable Yard’ Shiraz is an enchanting wine that showcases the rich flavors of South Africa’s Western Cape. Crafted from hand-harvested grapes, this Shiraz reveals rich red and black fruit layers, enhanced by subtle black pepper and delicate violet notes.

Carefully fermented and aged in old barrels, this medium-bodied Shiraz combines fruit-forward characteristics with a smooth, balanced palate. The meticulous winemaking process, including twice-daily pump-overs, ensures that each bottle delivers complexity and depth.

Perfect for pairing with slow-cooked meats like braised lamb or grilled pork, this Shiraz also pairs well with roasted vegetables or hearty stews.

products.title: 2023 Mount Rozier Reserve "Red Snapper" Cinsault
products.description_html:
The 2023 Mount Rozier Reserve 'Red Snapper' Cinsault from South Africa’s Western Cape showcases this lesser-known varietal’s subtle beauty. With ripe cherry, olive, and peppery spice flavors, this wine is a versatile pairing for a range of dishes.

Hand-harvested from sustainably farmed vineyards, this Cinsault’s grapes undergo a careful fermentation process to preserve their finesse and complexity. It is then barreled and matured for six months before bottling. The result is a wine with fine dry tannins and a concentrated palate, enhanced by a subtle hint of Turkish Delight.

Enjoy this wine with everything from shellfish to white meats, or explore its pairing potential with aged cheeses and charcuterie.

This 2021 Free Flight Pinot Noir reigns from California, home of luscious vineyards and laid-back vibes. The inland warmth versus cooler coast from various vineyards across the California region lend this pinot noir to be extra tasty. 

Flavors of cranberry, tart cherry, blackberry and even slight licorice come out to play against lower tannins and a light-to-medium body.

Because of its lighter body, this red does not overpower lighter meats like grilled chicken or simple beef tacos.

Discover the Abbazia Sparkling Moscato, a crisp, aromatic bubbly from Italy. This golden, straw-yellow wine features an intense, fruity, and fragrant bouquet with Moscato grape, musk, and floral notes. 

With its low alcohol content and perfect balance of sweetness and acidity, it’s ideal as a refreshing aperitif on hot days or as a base for brunch cocktails like Mimosas.

Best enjoyed with ice cream, pastries, and cakes, this Moscato is a delightful treat.

The palate reveals orange blossom, sweet Meyer lemon, and apricot notes, making it approachable and balanced.

Crafted with grapes sourced from California’s prime growing regions, this pink Moscato captures the lively essence of the Golden State. 

Perfect for any occasion, it pairs beautifully with rhubarb pie, fresh fruit parfait, or blackberry crumble with ice cream.

Hailing from sun-kissed vineyards, this Pinot benefits from the region’s climate, where warm days and cool nights nurture the grapes to perfection. On the palate, this light red wine reveals strawberry jam flavors and bright acidity balanced by portobello mushroom and crushed basil undertones. 

Pair this delightful Pinot Noir with lighter meat dishes like roast turkey sandwiches with cranberry sauce or crispy French bread topped with mixed cheeses and dried fruit.

Whether paired with grilled lamb chops, succulent pulled pork, or a savory meat-lovers pizza, this red blend harmonizes effortlessly with bold flavors and hearty meals.

This lush red promises complex fruit and creamy dark chocolate aromas, followed by a palate bursting with punchy plum, cherry, and toasted spice notes. Its pleasantly dry character, medium to full body, and robust tannins provide structure, while the finish is smooth, lingering with subtle hints of blackberry. 

Cultivated in an area with moderate summers, this Merlot brings out the best in rich meat dishes, making it the ideal companion for filet mignon, juicy burgers, or roasted lamb.

products.title: 2022 Cantina Di Solopaca Aglianico I.G.P.
products.description_html:
With a dry, harmonious, and velvety mouthfeel, our 2022 Cantina di Solopaca Aglianico Beneventano boasts 50 years of Italy’s long-lived passion for winemaking. Traditionally crafted by farmers, this wine is produced from Aglianico, a juicy black grape native to Southern Italy. 

During winemaking, the grapes are soft pressed, and the skins are continuously submerged into the must before fermentation. The result: a balanced wine with a pleasant mouthfeel and soft tannins.

With bold red fruit notes like strawberry, raspberry and a hint of spice, the semi-sweet taste interweaves with the dry tannic textures. The floral aromas and potent acidity make this wine a perfect match for hard cheeses and seafood.

products.title: Las Falleras Organic Cava Brut Rosé D.O.P.
products.description_html:
Las Falleras Organic Cava Brut Rosé is a sparkling rosé wine made with organically grown Garnacha grapes in Spain's Denominación de Origen Cava region. With its thick mousse of fine bubbles and deep bronze tinges, this wine offers fresh aromas of ripe red fruits. Its palate is light, crisp, and refreshing, with good acidity and a fruity finish. 

Ideal as an aperitif and to accompany desserts, this Cava shines when served cold between 4°C and 6°C. Embrace the elegance and sustainability of this organic sparkling rosé.

products.description_html:
Rewild Sustainable Moscato is a light and bright pale straw wine from the Murray Darling region of Australia. Its tropical array of passion fruit and citrus overtones, accompanied by stone fruit nuances and hints of grass, creates a crisp and luscious palate. Best enjoyed now, this Moscato pairs perfectly with fruit platters and sunshine. With minimal intervention and sustainability in mind, it's a testament to eco-conscious winemaking in the Southern Murray Darling.

Best enjoyed at a crisp 7°C, this wine pairs harmoniously with chargrilled prosciutto-wrapped cantaloupe slices, making it an ideal companion for your gatherings. It's also a perfect match for a summer fruit galette. Plus, it proudly carries a 100% vegan-friendly label.

Complex and unique lands are what allow for Chateau Guillaume Blanc to produce well-balanced, rich and structured wines in a number of different cuvées.

Situated near Sainte Foy la Grande on the outskirts of the Gironde, the wines produced at this 16th century Château enjoy a complex and unique terroir for their Cabernet and Merlot grapes. The domaine is Sustainable Agriculture certified and continues to manually prune their vines, and the result is elegant, rich and well-balanced wine with red fruit and sweet spice notes.

products.title: Flybird Ready-to-Drink Baja Lime Margarita
products.description_html:
Enjoy a bottle of ready-to-drink margarita agave cocktails—no bartender needed! From Flybird, this easy-sipping, classic Baja Lime Margarita cocktail was crafted in Mexico. Made with 100% Mexican agave wine, natural lime juice, dried orange, cane sugar, and water, this is margaritas made easy. 

A margarita is a cocktail that is traditionally tequila-based with a blend of orange liqueur and lime juice, served with salt on the rim of each glass and a lime wedge. Used for hundreds of years in Mexico, agave syrup is a sap derived from a native succulent cooked to release honey water, a natural sweetener. Using a process similar to making tequila, it is fermented and filtered, then mixed with all-natural ingredients to create authentic Mexican cocktails. 

Flybird is on a quest to craft the most delicious cocktails from all-natural ingredients. These bottles stay fresh after opening for up to two weeks, so simply twist off the top and pour over ice. This cocktail’s bright lemon-lime citrus flavor notes offer cool refreshment, evoking a little fun in the sun with every sip.  

Whether you are sitting poolside, lounging at the beach, or hosting Taco Tuesday with friends, grab a glass, some ice, and get ready to dive into delicious flavor with Flybird margarita agave wine cocktails!

blog_articles.title: 10 Wine Cocktails to Get Happy Hour Started Right
blog_articles.author: Macy's Wine Shop
blog_articles.content_html:
When planning a Soiree, opting for a traditional mixed drink, wine, or both is natural. But did you know that you can combine the two?

Making cocktails with wine is not a new thing, in fact, some of the recipes on our list have been around for one hundred years or more.

Keep reading for some of the best, easy-to-make wine cocktails that are sure to impress your friends and won’t break the bank.

Wine Cocktail Recipes

You don’t need to be a mixologist to craft the best-tasting sippers. We’ve compiled a list of the top ten classic and unique wine cocktail recipes that are delicious and refreshing.

1. White Wine Spritzer

One of the easiest recipes to impress your guests is a white wine spritzer, which requires just two ingredients. Grab an aromatic wine like Riesling, Sauvignon Blanc, or Gewürztraminer and add club soda. If you’d like a little extra flavor, add bitters or a lemon or lime twist. Throw in a few ice cubes, and you have a fancy, low-cost cocktail that tastes delicious.

2. Sangria

A sweet and delicious summer treat, Sangria recipes are a classic for a reason. All you need is an equal amount of red wine and brandy mixed with fresh squeezed orange juice and granulated sugar. Add orange slices and apples for an extra fruity taste. You can also add a little soda water or ginger ale if prefer your Sangria on the bubbly side.

If you prefer white wine cocktails, swap out the red wine for a dry white wine, and add mangos, peaches, seltzer, sugar, and orange liqueur for a lighter twist on the classic Sangria.

3. St. Germain

If you like sweet and floral mixed drinks on the low-alcohol side, St. Germain keeps it simple with sparkling wine, soda water, and a celery rib or cucumber slice for an added garnish. Brut sparkling wines like Champagne, Cava, or Prosecco are some of the most popular choices for this recipe.

4. Aperol Spritz

Similar to the St. Germain, with a little extra punch, an Aperol Spritz calls for Prosecco, Aperol, a splash of soda water, and an orange slice for serving. If you’ve not heard of the unique Italian aperitif that is Aperol, you’re not alone, as it’s not super common in American households. Essentially, it’s a bittersweet liqueur made from rhubarb, gentian root, and cinchona bark. It makes for a delicious kick in this refreshing wine-based cocktail.

5. Kir Royale

Traditionally served in a flute glass, the Kir Royale is a French cocktail consisting of Crème de Cassis and Champagne. Crème de Cassis is a sweet dark liqueur made from blackcurrants, so it adds a nice fruity twist to classic French sparkling wine. This lovely sipper dates back to 1904 at Café George in Dijon, France.

6. French 75

For something tried and true, the French 75 is believed to have originated in 1915 at the New York Bar in Paris. It’s just as classic as an Old-Fashioned Margherita, but its key ingredient of Champagne is what sets it apart from the aforementioned mixed drinks. Add fresh lemon juice or lime juice, simple syrup, Champagne, and a lemon peel for garnish, and you have an elegant French 75.

7. Mulled Wine

If you’ve ever visited a Christmas market in Europe, it’s likely you've seen an abundance of the traditional German holiday drink, Mulled Wine (or Glühwein in German). Served hot or warm, this cozy cocktail combines red wine with mulling spices, cinnamon, brandy, a hint of sugar, and fresh orange slices with cinnamon sticks for an added garnish. Some versions contain raisins or even a splash of Vodka for a spiked variation.

This European favorite is also older than you might think, as it dates back to the Romans and was even found in an English recipe book in the 1390s.

8. Classic Mimosa

The quintessential brunch sipper, the classic Mimosa is a go-to if you love a sweet wine drink. Add chilled Champagne or other white sparkling wine like Prosecco or Cava to fresh squeezed orange juice, and you’re set. For a bolder orange flavor, add a dash of orange liqueur and a lemon slice for garnish.

9. Americano

You might be surprised to find that a sophisticated wine-mixed drink like the classic Americano can be crafted with just three ingredients. All you need is Campari, sweet vermouth, club soda, and an orange slice if you prefer a garnish. Campari is an Italian bitter characterized by its vibrant red color and sweet, fruity taste, making it a great match for vermouth, which is a popular mixer in several classic cocktails.

10. Kalimotxo

For an incredibly unique red wine cocktail, the Kalimotxo has created a buzz all over Spain. Simply mix red wine with Mexican coke, then add a garnish like an orange slice or mint. It may sound odd to combine a wine with a soft drink, but this cocktail has been a classic in Spain since the 1920s, so it must be good.

Use These Wine Recipes to Get Your Party Started!

Now that you have several choices of red wine and white wine drinks at your fingertips for happy hour, it’s time to get crafting.

The great thing about these recipes is that they’re simple, easy to make, budget-friendly, and effortlessly fancy.

Shop all wines at our wine shop for an array of premium, affordable options you can use for your next cocktail party.

For more recipes and deep dives on all your favorite wines, check out the Wine Blog.

blog_articles.title: 5 Best Gifts for Wine Lovers
blog_articles.author: Macy's Wine Shop
blog_articles.content_html:
When looking for the perfect gift for the wine lover in your life, all the choices or not knowing which direction to take can leave you feeling stumped.

There’s absolutely nothing wrong with gifting a bottle of wine (we’re always for it!), but if you’re looking to give your beloved wine connoisseur a little something extra, you’ve come to the right place!

Keep reading for the ultimate gourmet wine gift guide to enhance your special occasions.

1. Unique Wine Gift Baskets

Whether you want to focus on one type or theme, like red wine, white wine, selections exclusively from Bordeaux, or celebrity picks like those from our Martha Stewart Collection, there are many ways to kick gourmet gifting up a notch.

Maybe the wine drinker you have in mind loves cozy, seasonal reds like warm Cabernet Sauvignon and earthy Pinot Noir. If they prefer crisp white wine, sparkling wine sets may be perfect for them. You could also give them the gift of luxury with Luxe Sets from around the world.

Shop our popular Gift Sets for fresh and unique choices for everyone.

You can also adjust the size and budget of your gift set depending on your needs. Shop 3 Bottle Wine Sets, 6 Bottle Sets, 12 Bottle Sets, and selections under $100!

2. Stainless Steel Wine Glasses

When shopping for a fellow wine lover, odds are they have glasses galore. But what about gifting them something sleeker? Stainless steel wine glasses and tumblers are durable, easy to clean, and add extra shine to any tasting party. This could be an excellent way to add something different to their wine glass collection.

3. Wine Opener Upgrade

There’s more to openers than the standard winged corkscrew that requires drinkers to twist manually. Thanks to upgraded wine technology, you can open a bottle of wine with the touch of a button. Seek out electric corkscrews that require the opener to simply place and press. There are also pump options, allowing you to place the opener over the top of the bottle while pressing and pulling the lever.

Wine preservation systems are also available, which keep the bottle sealed after opening to prevent oxidation. As any wine lover knows, the countdown begins as soon as the cork is out, so this could also be an excellent gift idea.

With so many ways to open a wine bottle, give your wine lover the gift of ease this season!

4. Crystal Decanter

At first glance, crystal and glass decanters appear to be the same. However, did you know that crystal decanters are much more resilient than glass? While appearing thin, crystal is a harder yet more pliable material than glass. Glass decanters may be pretty, but they are more prone to breakage.

Plus, there is a range of crystal decanter sizes to choose from depending on your giftee’s favorite wine. For example, maybe they’d like a long-spouted decanter similar to a swan next. Smaller decanters are great for lighter red wines, while larger-based decanters are excellent for robust red blends.

Regardless, make sure it’s a crystal for extra durability. Your loved one will surely regard you as a wine expert!

5. Exclusive Wine Club Membership

What better gift than the gift of choice? If you’re unsure whether your giftee likes red or white, a Wine Club Membership will open them up to endless options. At Macy’s Wine Shop, your gifte could enjoy a curated selection of 6 wines for a limited-time offer of just $49.99!

Gifting them a wine subscription will surely make their year.

6. DIY Wine Gift Basket

For an extra personal touch, why not build a wine basket from scratch? This way, you can include all your loved one's favorite wines plus extra gourmet treats. Add unique cheeses, fresh fruit, chocolate, crackers, olives, and a card. These are just a few ideas, as you can customize your DIY gift basket any way you choose.

Make your loved one feel extra special with something handmade.

Give the Gift of Wine Your Way!

As the holiday season nears and gift shopping climbs to the top of our lists, we hope these ideas are helpful as you shop for the wine enthusiast in your life. These unique choices will surely bring joy to your fellow oenophiles.

Shop an array of affordable, carefully selected wines at Macy’s Wine Shop as you venture into your wine gifting journey.

For more ideas and other exclusive wine information, visit The Wine Blog.

When shopping for the perfect wine gift, Macy’s wine shop has you covered. Remove the shopping stress and spend more time with loved ones this holiday!

blog_articles.title: A Deep Dive into Portuguese Wines
blog_articles.author: Macy's Wine Shop
blog_articles.content_html:
Most of us have sipped a lovely glass of Port as an after-dinner treat, but did you know that this fortified wine’s country of origin has so much more to offer?

From popular table wines to exotic varietals, Portugal’s wine industry is versatile and booming. The country’s scenery also provides a vast range of climates and terrain, so there is nothing short of its natural beauty.

Let’s explore Portugal’s landscapes and see what its wine scene is all about.

Portuguese Wines by Region

Because Portugal’s regions are so interconnected with their famous wines, we must look at all of them to gain a complete perspective. Grab your vacation gear and get ready for a tasting tour. We’ve got fourteen famous wine regions to cover!

Vinho Verde

Home to nine subregions, Vinho Verde sits at the top of Northern Portugal. It is most famous for its young variations of red, white, and rose wines that are crisp and aromatic. Perhaps the most well-known varietal comes in the form of a sparkling white wine (Vinho Branco) of the same name. Vinho Verde is extra refreshing when sipped on the breezy coasts of Mainland Portugal. This white wine also comes in red wine (Vinho Tinto) and Rosé (Vinho Rosé) forms.

Porto and Douro

The Douro Valley is famously home to Portugal’s finest grape variety, Touriga Nacional, a black-skinned noir grape. This wine-producing region boasts the country’s highest wine classification, the Denominação de Origem Controlada (DOC). Douro is also known for producing the beloved fortified wine, Port (Vinho do Porto). Here you’ll find everything from the young Ruby Port to the age-worthy Tawny Port as well as White Port and Reserve Port.

Douro is one of Portugal’s leading red wine producers, with other well-known grape varieties like Tinta Rouriz, Touriga Francesca, Tinta Barroca, and Tinta Cao, all used to make the spirited dessert wine.

In this region, you’ll also find the city of Port, located near Vila Real and the Douro River. This area has been one of the leading exporters of Port wine for several centuries.

Trás-os-Montes

Isolated by mountainous terrain, it’s the dry, boiling summers and icy winters that produce red wines in both robust and aromatic forms. Because this region is so remote and of a much higher altitude than neighboring Douro, it can be difficult to travel to.

If you do happen to grab your hiking boots and make the trek, you can sample the famous full-bodied, high-alcohol red wine, Transmontano. Trás-os-Montes also produces the prized Vinho dos Mortos (the Wine of the Dead), which was historically coveted by France.

Távora-Varosa

Resting along the borders of the Douro DOC, Tavora-Varosa is most famous for its sparkling wines. If you love Champagne bursting with refreshing acidity, Pinot Noir, or Chardonnay, you can find all these wines in this small region.

Bairrada

Baga is the most widely harvested grape variety in Bairrada and is at the heart of most of this region’s red wines and sparkling wines. Wines like Tinto Bairrada and Branco Bairrada range from incredibly robust and tannic to delicate and perfumey. If you love a breezy sparkling white wine with a hint of beeswax textures, don’t shy away from Brut Bairrada.

Dão

Southwest of Douro lies the mountainous, forested Dao region. It is here where the rugged, granite soils produce robust, highly tannic red wine grapes that are prime for aging. Labeled under the same name as the region, Dao red wines range from medium to full-bodied and boast decadent flavors of raspberry, licorice, spice, black fruit, chocolate, and mocha. Wine experts have deemed Dao a region to watch in terms of quality.

Beira Interior

Inundated with snowfall in the winter and short, hot summers, growing grapes in this mountainous region is quite a challenge. The red wines here are incredibly fruity and juicy, complemented by herbaceous, smoky notes. Tinto Beira is one of this region’s most famous red wines and is made from DOC grapes like Touriga Nacional.

White wines in Beira Interior, like Branco Beira, are lean and chalky with an intense mineral finish.

Lisboa

Also known as Lisbon, this region is just below Central Portugal. Lisbon is Portugal’s largest city and is also its capital. The region rests along the west coast and reaps the benefits of the Atlantic Ocean, which provides Lisboa’s mostly white wine grapes with high acidity and bright aromas. Lisboa consists of three subregions; Colares, Bucelas, and Carcavelos, all famous for their elegant, dry white wines.

Algarve

With sandy beaches and lush red wines similar to those in Australia, you will find juicy, spice-infused Syrah and Tempranillo in the Algarve region. Most of these delicious reds are made with the Touriga Nacional grape, meaning that Algarve’s wines are nothing short of supreme quality. This region lies in the southernmost part of Portugal.

Alentejo

Located in the heart of Portugal lies the Tejo region, which is the largest producer of most table wines you will find in the United States. When visiting Alentejo (or Tejo for short), you will find everything from Cabernet Sauvignon to Merlot to Chardonnay and much more. Keep an eye out for those made from famous Portuguese grapes like Touriga Nacional, Arinto, and Malvasia Fina.

Alentejo is Portugal’s largest wine region and produces some of the best Portuguese red wines with plum, spice, and pepper flavors.

Setubal

Along the Tagus River lies the Península de Setúbal, which is just above the southern Algarve region. This coastal region’s sandy terroir is perhaps most famous for producing the sweet and fruity dessert wine, Moscatel de Setúbal. Port may have found a competitor in Moscatel de Setúbal, as this golden fortified wine tastes like honey, dried apricots, and caramel, depending on the type.

Azores and Madeira Islands

Moving on to Portugal’s autonomous regions, you won’t find these places in Continental Portugal. Azores (also known as Pico Island) and Madeira are known for producing sweet, tart, and smoky wines grown in volcanic soils. Azores is explicitly famous for Vinho de Cheiro, which is a light red wine that is sweet and fragrant. It is also very low in alcohol, which makes it an easy sipper.

In Madeira, the most famous wine this region produces is, in fact, Madeira, which is a fortified wine popular for both sipping and drinking. This wine has a distinct salt and pepper flavor with common notes of orange peel, caramel, hazelnut, peach, and brown sugar. It is both a sweet and savory treat.

Continue Exploring Portuguese Wines!

Now that we’ve traveled through Portugal’s wine regions, you’ll be able to recognize the country’s most prolific varietals.

Shop these famous Portuguese wines at our Macy’s Wine Shop. We offer several esteemed varieties, including a Rosé from the Vinho Verde D.O.C. and a Vinho Branco from the Dao D.O.C.

Want more wine region deep dives? Visit the Macy’s Wine Shop Blog for all the wine information you’ll need!

blog_articles.title: A Deep Look into California Wine Country
blog_articles.author: Macy's Wine Shop
blog_articles.content_html:
If you’re looking for the perfect wine-tasting state, did you know that more than 80% of wine from the United States is crafted in California?

Not far behind Italy, France, and Spain, the Golden State is one of the world’s top wine producers.

While you might know about the famous Napa and Sonoma Counties, there are actually so many more regions to explore.

Buckle up as we take you through everything you need to know about wine country in California.

California Wine Regions

California is currently home to 139 American Viticultural Areas or AVAs for short.

The first vines were planted in California in the late 18th century by Franciscan Friars as part of over twenty missions planted throughout the state.

The wine industry took a dive until around the 1960s due to the effects of prohibition. Sadly, in the 1990s, many Northern California vineyards were lost and had to be replanted after the global Phylloxera epidemic.

After more trial and error, the perfect terroir and varietal combinations were found, and the wine industry began to thrive once again.

Now that we have a little bit of background on California winemaking let’s explore the extensive map of California’s wine country.

North Coast

At glorious elevations with breathtaking views of the Pacific Ocean, the Mendocino Ridge remains mostly wild and untamed. After driving through the majestic redwoods just a few hours away from San Francisco, you’ll find yourself in the artistic community of Mendocino County.

The top wine varietals to try in this region include Pinot and Chardonnay. For famous AVAs, check out Anderson Valley and Cole Ranch.

For wineries, check out locations like Meyer Family Cellars and Mia Bea Wines.

Lake County

With some of the first vineyards having been imported by an English actress in the 1880s, Lake County is just as beautiful as Napa Valley and Sonoma without the price tag. The area is named for Clear Lake, the largest natural lake in California.

Top varietals in this area include none other than Cabernet Sauvignon, Petite Syrah, Sauvignon Blanc, and Tempranillo.

Famous AVAs include High Valley and Red Hills, with famous wineries like Hawk and Horse Vineyards and Steele Wines.

Napa Valley

The three wines that reign king when you think of Napa Valley wine remain to be Cabernet Sauvignon, Pinot Noir, and Chardonnay. Famous AVAs in Napa County include St. Helena and Yountville.

With a mix of soils ranging from volcanic to the cool valley floor, Napa is home to an extraordinary variety of grapes and diverse terrain.

Visit famous wineries like Lobo Wines and Volker Eisele Family Estate for an exquisite tasting room experience.

Sonoma County

Not far from Napa is the foggy, cool climate of Sonoma County, with famous vineyards scattered across the Russian River Valley and Green Valley.

Visit wineries like Blanchard Family Wines as you explore the artistic scenery and sip to your heart’s content.

Central Coast

With famous cities like San Francisco and the York Mountains, this area is surprisingly an often overlooked area for wine lovers.

Here’s what you can find at the lovely Central Coast:

San Francisco Bay Area

Nestled in the Santa Cruz Mountains are renowned vineyards like Eden Estate Wines, where the most prolific wines remain Cabernet Sauvignon and Pinot Noir. With beautiful cliffs, hillsides, and a feeling of quaint remoteness, the Bay Area is an incredibly relaxing destination for wine tasting.

Monterey County

Home to famous actors and directors like Clint Eastwood, the fresh fruit from this AVA is highly prized. With beautiful hilly and green landscapes like Carmel Valley, the Santa Lucia Highlands, and Arroyo Seco, prime sippers include lush Merlot, Pinot Noir, and Chardonnay.

San Luis Obispo

Off the beaten path between major cities like San Francisco and Los Angeles, San Luis Obispo County is home to the fast-growing wine scene of Paso Robles and the Famous Castoro Cellars.

Wines to sip here include Pinot Noir, Chardonnay, and Rhone Style varietals.

Santa Barbara

Home to the gorgeous Santa Maria Valley and Santa Rita Hills, Santa Barbara boasts both cool climate and warm climate varietals.

Famous wines to sip here include Syrah, Pinot Noir, and Chardonnay.

Sierra Foothills

Home to Eldorado County’s Placerville and Apple Hill for winetasting, the mountainous areas of the Sierra Foothills make for a peaceful sipping experience.

Top varietals to taste include bold reds like Zinfandel and Syrah, while some of the best wineries include Myka Estates and Andis Wines.

Central Valley

Traveling south to the Central Valley viticulture area, which encompasses Sacramento and San Joaquin Valley, is the town of Lodi. This area has been home to flourishing vineyards since the 19th century. With warm, jammy Zinfandel and bold Cabernet Sauvignon, the valley's heat allows these varietals to thrive.

For wineries, be sure to visit Rescue Dog Wines and Le Czar Vineyard.

Taste Your Way Through Highway 101

We hope you’ve enjoyed this adventure through our California Wine Country map.

You’re now ready to embark on a wonderful tasting journey through the historic Golden Coast.

Enjoy fantastic and affordable wines from all over the United States and California at Macy’s Wine Shop.

For more deep dives into your favorite wine regions, visit The Wine Blog. It’s your guide to drinking and enjoying wine!

blog_articles.title: A Guide to Australia's Wine Regions
blog_articles.author: Macy's Wine Shop
blog_articles.content_html:
Australia is known for its extraordinary wildlife, hot climate, and vast landscapes.

But it's more than kangaroos and red desserts, as the Great Outback is home to many prolific wine regions.

In fact, did you know that Australia is famous for its Shiraz and Chardonnay?

With so many varieties to explore, let’s uncover what Australia’s glorious wine regions have to offer.

History of Australia’s Viticulture

Australia's wine business is booming with 100 grape varieties across 65 wine regions.

The top wines here are Chardonnay, Shiraz, and Cabernet Sauvignon, but Grenache, Mourvèdre, Pinot Noir, Riesling, and Sauvignon Blanc are also popular.

Australia’s winemaking dates back to 1788 when the New South Wales Colony governor, Arthur Philip, brought the first vines to modern-day Sydney. These vine cuttings were Shiraz and Grenache from France and Spain.

40 years later, James Busby became known as “the father of Aussie wine” and pioneered fortified wine as an international export.

It wasn’t until the 1960s and 70s that Aussie wines became more focused on table wines than fortified wines. This was quite a shift as fortified wines comprised 75% of the market, inspiring winemakers to produce diverse, high-quality products for international and domestic enjoyment.

By the mid-2000s, Australia achieved status as the fourth highest-valued wine region in the world.

Let’s explore the beautiful and diverse regions that make the country’s wine industry what it is today.

Major Australian Wine Regions

Australia is home to five major wine states with over eight famous wine regions. With climates that vary from desert-like to coastal, and soils ranging from sandy to clay, there are almost unlimited expressions. These conditions are what allow Australia to produce an array of delicious sparkling wines, red wines, and white wines of all types.

Let’s dive into the major wine regions to learn more!

Tamar Valley

Tamar Valley is located in Tasmania, a large land mass off the coast of Victoria in the south. With a cool climate and rich, nutrient-dense soil that the Tamar River nourishes, this valley produces 40% of Australia’s premium wines. Tamar Valley tends to have cool breezes, clear skies in the spring and summer, and frigid winters. The cold helps to produce quality sparkling wines like Champagne and esteemed white wines like Chardonnay, Sauvignon Blanc, Riesling, and Pinot Gris.

While it may seem like there’s no need to look beyond the Tamar Valley for the best sparkling and white wines in Australia, there is still so much quality to explore. We’re just getting started!

Margaret River

Lush forests, ancient caves, and a spectacular coastline surround Margaret River, a quaint town in Western Australia. It’s located near the Indian Ocean, with a Mediterranean climate perfect for producing notable Australian red wines like Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, and Shiraz. Margaret River also boasts spectacular white wines like Chardonnay, Sauvignon Blanc, Chenin Blanc, and Verdelho.

Clare Valley

The Clare Valley is located in South Australia and was formed by the Hutt River. It’s known for producing some of the best cool-climate white wines, notably its rich-tasting Riesling. With beautifully lush grasslands blanketing its vineyards, Clare Valley is a must-visit if you love fine white wines. Be sure to check out famous wineries like Taylor Wines when you go!

Yarra Valley

Just one hour northeast of Melbourne, Yarra Valley surrounds the Yarra River in Victoria. The topography here includes bushland and flatter valleys where most of this region’s grapes are grown. The most well-known wines in this region are savory Shiraz and silky, medium-bodied Cabernet Sauvignon varieties.

The cooler climate has also helped the area gain notoriety for its lighter-bodied reds like Pinot Noir. If white wines are more your thing, you’re in for a treat as Yarra Valley also boasts light, aromatic sparkling wines and buttery Chardonnay.

Eden Valley

Near the Barossa Valley, the Eden Valley wine region is located in South Australia and consists of a warm climate almost year-round with mostly clear skies in the winter. Within its hilly landscapes, most grapes planted here are Shiraz, Riesling, Cabernet Sauvignon, and Chardonnay. While Riesling and Shiraz are its signature varieties, Eden Valley is also known for its Merlot, Sauvignon Blanc, Semillon, and Pinot Gris.

Barossa Valley

The Barossa Valley is one of Australia’s most well-known wine-producing regions and is located less than an hour from Adelaide, the largest city in Southern Australia. Credited to its isolated location from the rest of the world, it contains some of the oldest living vines. Because of where it sits, it managed to avoid the Phylloxera epidemic in the late 1800s, which affected most of the world’s wine industry.

The Barossa Valley is a popular tourist destination and is most well known for its esteemed red wine. In particular, Shiraz is most notable here. You’ll enjoy a breezy Mediterranean climate when walking through Barossa’s vineyards.

Hunter Valley

Founded by James Busby, Hunter Valley contains 150 wineries and is most famous for its Semillon, although Chardonnay and Shiraz are also gaining notoriety here. A few hours from Sydney, the Mediterranean climate provides warm summers and mild winters, with an ocean breeze that dries and nourishes the grapes. The soil consistency ranges from sand-like to clay, which offers a lot of growth potential for winemakers.

Mornington Peninsula

The Mornington Peninsula hosts one of Victoria’s cooler climates, contributing to delicious and fruity Pinot Noir. It boasts beachside stone cottages and a cool ocean breeze, making it a charming destination for locals and tourists alike. The breathtaking architecture is courtesy of German settlers’ arrival in the 19th century. Shiraz grapes are this region’s specialty but share a focus on Cabernet Sauvignon, Grenache Shiraz Mourvèdre, and Malbec. The red clay soils here produce some of the world's most acclaimed samples of these varieties.

Praise for Wine Down Under

With years to perfect grape varietals like Shiraz and a history of successfully exporting fortified wines, Australia has made a name among the world’s finest wine regions.

Diverse climates and soils have contributed to Australia’s ability to adapt to growing domestic wine needs. Now, the country boasts exclusive wine varietals, like Champagne, which can only be found in Tamar Valley, Tasmania.

Australia also avoided the Phylloxera epidemic entirely, so tourists can enjoy some of Australia’s first vineyards still standing today. Shop our wine selection for a sample of decadent Australian wines, and check out The Insider’s Blog for more insights on some of the world’s top wine regions.
